Volume 5 Annals 5: Emperor Wen

Chapter 5 of 宋書 ✓ Translated

Chapter 5

1
景平二年七月中，少帝廢。 百官備法駕奉迎，入奉皇統。 行臺至江陵，進璽紱。 侍中臣琇、散騎常侍臣嶷之、中書監尚書令護軍將軍建城縣公臣亮、左衞將軍臣景仁、給事中游擊將軍龍鄉縣侯臣隆、越騎校尉都亭侯臣綱、給事黃門侍郎臣孔璩之、散騎侍郎臣劉思考、員外散騎侍郎臣潘盛、中書侍郎臣何尚之、羽林監封陽縣開國侯臣蕭思話、長兼尚書左丞德陽縣侯臣孫康、吏部郎中騎都尉臣張茂度、儀曹郎中臣徐長琳、倉部郎中臣庾俊之、都官郎中臣袁洵等上表曰：「臣聞否泰相革，數窮則變，天道所以不謟，卜世所以靈長。 乃者運距陵夷，王室艱晦，九服之命，靡所適歸，高祖之業，將墜于地。 賴基厚德深，人神同奬，社稷以寧，有生獲乂。 伏惟陛下君德自然，聖明在御，孝悌著於家邦，風猷宣於蕃牧。 是以徵祥雜沓，符瑞㸌煇。 宗廟神靈，乃眷西顧，萬邦黎獻，望景託生。 臣等忝荷朝列，豫充將命，復集休明之運，再覩太平之業。 行臺至止，瞻望城闕，不勝喜說鳧藻之情，謹詣門拜表以聞。 」上答曰：「皇運艱弊，數鍾屯夷，仰惟崇基，感尋國故，永慕厥躬，悲慨交集。 賴七百祚永，股肱忠賢，故能休否以泰，天人式序。 猥以不德，謬降大命，顧己兢悸，何以克堪。 輒當暫歸朝庭，展哀陵寢，并與賢彥申寫所懷。 望體其心，勿為辭費。 」府州佐史並稱臣，請題牓諸門，一依宮省，上不許。 甲戌，發江陵。 八月丙申，車駕至京城。 [1]丁酉，謁初寧陵，還於中堂即皇帝位。
In the middle of the seventh month of Jingping 2 (424 CE), the young emperor was deposed. The officials arrayed the imperial carriage to welcome him and install him in the imperial line. When the mobile secretariat reached Jiangling, it presented the imperial seal and ribbon. Palace Attendant Pei, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Yi, Director of the Palace Library and Director of the Masters of Writing Protector of the Army Duke of Jiancheng Liang, General of the Left Guard Jingren, Gentlemen of the Palace and General Who Strikes in Guerrilla Warfare Marquis of Longxiang Long, Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Marquis of Duting Gang, Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Kong Qunzhi, Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Liu Sikao, Extraordinary Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Pan Sheng, Attendant of the Palace Library He Shangzhi, Supervisor of the Forest Guards Marquis Who Opens a State of Fengyang Xiao Sihua, Concurrent Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Marquis of Deyang Sun Kang, Director of the Ministry of Personnel Commandant of Cavalry Zhang Maodu, Director of the Ministry of Rites Xu Changlin, Director of the Ministry of Revenue Yu Junzhi, Director of the Ministry of Justice Yuan Xun, and others submitted a memorial: "We have heard that adversity and prosperity succeed each other, and when fate runs its course change follows—this is why Heaven’s way never grows stale and why auguries for a dynasty’s endurance hold true." Of late the age had declined, the royal house was in distress, and the mandate of the nine domains had nowhere to rest; the High Ancestor’s founding enterprise was on the verge of collapse. Thanks to your profound virtue and deep foundation, men and spirits alike lent their aid, the altars were secured, and the people were brought to peace. We respectfully consider that Your Majesty’s sovereign virtue is innate, your sagely brilliance holds the throne, filial piety and brotherly duty are manifest in your family and state, and your moral influence is proclaimed in the domains you govern. Hence auspicious omens crowded in and talismans blazed with brilliance. The spirits of the ancestral temple turned their gaze westward; the myriad states and all the people looked to your radiance and entrusted their lives to you. We, who unworthily bear office at court, were privileged to carry your command and have again gathered in this age of splendor to witness an enterprise of great peace once more. The mobile secretariat has arrived; gazing upon the capital walls, we cannot contain our joy; we respectfully come to the gate to bow and submit this memorial for your notice. The Emperor replied: "The imperial fortune has been hard pressed and the cycle has struck repeated adversity. Looking up to the lofty foundation, I feel the nation’s past and forever mourn that person; grief and agitation mingle together." Relying on the enduring fortune of the seven hundred years and on loyal, worthy arms and legs of the throne, we have been able to turn adversity to prosperity and put Heaven and man in their proper order. I am unworthy and have wrongly received the great mandate; looking back at myself, how could I bear it? I shall for the time being return to court, display mourning at the imperial tombs, and together with worthy men fully express what is in my heart. I hope you will enter into my feelings and not make excessive protestations. The prefectural and district aides all styled themselves subjects and asked to inscribe plaques on every gate according to the palace standard; the Emperor did not permit it. On jiaxu, he set out from Jiangling. On bingshen of the eighth month, the imperial carriage reached the capital. On dingyou, he paid respects at the Chuning Mausoleum, then returned to the central hall and there assumed the imperial throne.
2
元嘉元年秋八月丁酉，大赦天下，改景平二年為元嘉元年。 文武賜位二等，逋租宿債勿復收。 庚子，以行撫軍將軍、荊州刺史謝晦為撫軍將軍、荊州刺史。 癸卯，司空、錄尚書事、揚州刺史徐羨之進位司徒，衞將軍、江州刺史王弘進位司空，中書監、護軍將軍傅亮加左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，撫軍將軍、荊州刺史謝晦進號衞將軍，鎮北將軍、南兗州刺史檀道濟進號征北將軍。 甲辰，追尊所生胡婕妤為皇太后，諡曰章后。 衞將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康進號驃騎將軍，冠軍將軍、南豫州刺史義恭進號撫軍將軍，封江夏王。 立第六皇弟義宣為竟陵王，第七皇弟義季為衡陽王。 戊申，以豫州刺史劉粹為雍州刺史，驍騎將軍管義之為豫州刺史，南蠻校尉到彥之為中領軍。 己酉，減荊、湘二州今年稅布之半。
On dingyou of the eighth month of autumn in Yuanjia 1 (424 CE), a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire, and Jingping 2 was changed to Yuanjia 1. Civil and military officials were advanced two ranks in status; overdue rents and old debts were not to be collected again. On gengzi, Acting Pacifying Army General and Jingzhou Inspector Xie Hui was confirmed as Pacifying Army General and Jingzhou Inspector. On guimao, Minister of Works, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, and Yangzhou Inspector Xu Xianzhi was promoted to Grand Commandant; General Who Guards the Army and Jiangzhou Inspector Wang Hong was promoted to Minister of Works; Director of the Palace Library and Protector of the Army Fu Liang was given the additional title of Left Grand Master of the Palace and Bearer of the Golden Battle-Ax, Opening Office with the same ceremonial as the Three Excellencies; Pacifying Army General and Jingzhou Inspector Xie Hui was given the title General Who Guards the Army; General Who Pacifies the North and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Tan Daoji was given the title General Who Campaigns in the North. On jiachen, his birth mother, Lady Hu the Talented Beauty, was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager with the posthumous title Empress Zhang. General Who Guards the Army and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was given the title General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief; General Who Conquers and Southern Yuzhou Inspector Yigong was given the title Pacifying Army General and enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia. The sixth younger imperial brother Yixuan was established as Prince of Jingling, and the seventh younger imperial brother Yiji as Prince of Hengyang. On wushen, Yuzhou Inspector Liu Cui was made Yongzhou Inspector, General of Valiant Cavalry Guan Yizhi was made Yuzhou Inspector, and Colonel of the Southern Man Dao Yanzhi was made General of the Central Army. On jiyou, this year’s cloth tax in Jing and Xiang provinces was reduced by half.
3
九月丙子，立妃袁氏為皇后。
On bingzi of the ninth month, Consort Yuan was established as Empress.
4
二年春正月丙寅，司徒徐羨之、尚書令傅亮奉表歸政，上始親覽。 辛未，車駕祠南郊，[2]大赦天下。
On bingyin of the first month of spring in year 2, Grand Commandant Xu Xianzhi and Director of the Masters of Writing Fu Liang submitted a memorial returning power to the throne, and the Emperor began to handle affairs personally. On xinwei, the imperial carriage performed sacrifice at the southern suburban altar, and a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.
5
三月乙丑，左將軍、徐州刺史王仲德進號安北將軍。
On yichou of the third month, General of the Left and Xuzhou Inspector Wang Zhongde was given the title General Who Pacifies the North.
6
夏五月戊寅，特進謝澹卒。
In summer, on wuyin of the fifth month, Special Grand Master Xie Dan died.
7
秋八月甲申，以關中流民出漢川，置京兆、扶風、馮翊等郡。 乙酉，驃騎將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康為開府儀同三司，新除司空王弘為車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，以右軍長史江恒為廣州刺史。
In autumn, on jiashen of the eighth month, because refugees from Guanzhong had left for the Han River region, the commanderies of Jingzhao, Fufeng, and Pingyi were established. On yiyou, General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was given Opening Office with the same ceremonial as the Three Excellencies; the newly appointed Minister of Works Wang Hong was made General of Chariots and Cavalry, Opening Office with the same ceremonial as the Three Excellencies; Chief Clerk of the Right Army Jiang Heng was made Guangzhou Inspector.
8
冬十一月癸酉，以前將軍楊玄為征西將軍、北秦州刺史。
In winter, on guiyou of the eleventh month, former General Yang Xuan was made General Who Campaigns in the West and Qinzhou Inspector of the North.
9
三年春正月丙寅，司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史徐羨之，尚書令、護軍將軍、左光祿大夫傅亮，有罪伏誅。 遣中領軍到彥之、征北將軍檀道濟討荊州刺史謝晦，上親率六師西征。 大赦天下。 丁卯，以車騎大將軍、江州刺史王弘為司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史，驃騎將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康改為荊州刺史，撫軍將軍、南豫州刺史江夏王義恭改為南徐州刺史。 己巳，以前護軍將軍趙倫之為鎮軍將軍。
On bingyin of the first month of spring in year 3, Grand Commandant, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, and Yangzhou Inspector Xu Xianzhi, and Director of the Masters of Writing, Protector of the Army, and Left Grand Master of the Palace Fu Liang, having committed crimes, were executed. General of the Central Army Dao Yanzhi and General Who Campaigns in the North Tan Daoji were sent to campaign against Jingzhou Inspector Xie Hui; the Emperor personally led the six armies on a western expedition. A general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire. On dingmao, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Jiangzhou Inspector Wang Hong was made Grand Commandant, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, and Yangzhou Inspector; General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was changed to Jingzhou Inspector; Pacifying Army General and Southern Yuzhou Inspector Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was changed to Southern Xuzhou Inspector. On jisi, former Protector of the Army Zhao Lunzhi was made General Who Guards the Army.
10
閏月丙戌，皇子劭生。
On bingxu of the intercalary month, the imperial son Shao was born.
11
二月乙卯，繫囚見徒，一皆原赦。 戊午，以金紫光祿大夫王敬弘為尚書左僕射，豫章太守鄭鮮之為尚書右僕射。 建安太守潘盛有罪伏誅。 [3]庚申，特進范泰加光祿大夫。 是日，車駕發京師。 戊辰，到彥之、檀道濟大破謝晦於隱磯。 丙子，車駕自蕪湖反斾。 己卯，擒晦於延頭，送京師伏誅。
On yimao of the second month, all prisoners in custody and convicts in exile were entirely pardoned. On wuwu, Jinzi-guanglu Grand Master Wang Jinghong was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Zhangzhang Prefect Zheng Xianzhi was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing. Jian’an Prefect Pan Sheng, having committed a crime, was executed. On gengshen, Special Grand Master Fan Tai was given the additional title of Grand Master of the Palace. That day, the imperial carriage set out from the capital. On wuchen, Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji inflicted a great defeat on Xie Hui at Yinji. On bingzi, the imperial carriage turned its banners back from Wuhu. On jimao, Hui was captured at Yantou and sent to the capital, where he was executed.
12
三月辛巳，車駕還宮。
On xinsi of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
13
夏五月乙未，以征北將軍、南兗州刺史檀道濟為征南大將軍、江州刺史，中領軍到彥之為南豫州刺史。 戊戌，以後將軍長沙王義欣為南兗州刺史。 乙巳，驃騎大將軍、涼州牧大沮渠蒙遜改為車騎大將軍。 詔曰：「夫哲王宰世，廣達四聰，猶巡嶽省方，採風觀政。 所以情偽必審，幽遐罔滯，王澤無擁，九皐有聞者也。 朕以寡薄，猥纂洪緒。 雖永念治道，志存昧旦，願言傅巖，發想宵寐，而丘園之秀，藏器未臻，物情民隱，尚隔視聽。 乃眷區域，輟寢忘飡。 今氛祲袪蕩，宇內寧晏，旌賢弘化，於是乎始。 可遣大使巡行四方。 其宰守稱職之良，閨蓽一介之善，詳悉列奏，勿或有遺。 若刑獄不卹，政治乖謬，傷民害教者，具以事聞。 其高年、鰥寡、幼孤、六疾不能自存者，可與郡縣優量賑給。 博採輿誦，廣納嘉謀，務盡銜命之旨，俾若朕親覽焉。 」丙午，車駕臨延賢堂聽訟。
In summer, on yiwei of the fifth month, General Who Campaigns in the North and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Tan Daoji was made General Who Campaigns in the South and Jiangzhou Inspector; General of the Central Army Dao Yanzhi was made Southern Yuzhou Inspector. On wuxu, Rear General Prince of Changsha Yixin was made Southern Xuzhou Inspector. On yisi, General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief and Liangzhou Governor Juqu Mengxun was changed to General of Chariots and Cavalry. An edict said: "When a wise king governs the age, he broadly extends the four kinds of hearing, yet still tours the sacred mountains and inspects the regions, gathering the winds and observing government." Thus the true and false are surely examined, the remote and hidden are not neglected, royal favor is not blocked, and the nine marshes have those who hear. I, with my meager virtue, have unworthily inherited the great enterprise. Though I forever ponder the way of governance and keep my purpose at dawn, longing to speak of Fu Yue I rise from sleep at night—yet the worthy in hill and garden, their talents still unrevealed, and the people’s hidden hardships remain cut off from sight and hearing. Therefore I turn my regard to the regions and pause my rest, forgetting to eat. Now the baleful omens have been swept away, and within the four seas there is tranquility; to display the worthy and expand transformation begins from this moment. Grand envoys may be dispatched to tour the four quarters. Those prefects and magistrates who are good at their duties, and every fine quality in humble cottage or byre, are to be reported in full detail in memorials—let nothing be omitted. If criminal cases are not relieved, if government is perverse and mistaken, or if the people are harmed and teaching injured, report the facts in full. Those of advanced age, widowers and widows, orphans and the young, and the six kinds of affliction who cannot support themselves may be given relief according to the best measure of the commandery and county. Broadly gather popular songs, widely receive excellent counsel, and exhaust the intent of those bearing the mandate, as if I myself were viewing it. On bingwu, the imperial carriage attended at the Hall for Honoring the Worthy to hear litigation.
14
六月己未，以鎮軍將軍趙倫之為左光祿大夫、領軍將軍。 丙寅，車駕又於延賢堂聽訟。 丙子，又聽訟。 以右衞王華為中護軍。
On jiwei of the sixth month, General Who Guards the Army Zhao Lunzhi was made Left Grand Master of the Palace and General of the Palace Guard. On bingyin, the imperial carriage again attended at the Hall for Honoring the Worthy to hear litigation. On bingzi, he again heard litigation. General of the Right Guard Wang Hua was made General of the Central Guard.
15
冬十一月戊寅，以梁、南秦二州刺史吉翰為益州刺史，驃騎參軍劉道產為梁、南秦二州刺史。 己亥，以南蠻校尉劉遵考為雍州刺史。
In winter, on wuyin of the eleventh month, Liang and Southern Qin Inspector Ji Han was made Yizhou Inspector, and Staff Officer of the General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief Liu Daochan was made Liang and Southern Qin Inspector. On jihai, Colonel of the Southern Man Liu Zunkao was made Yongzhou Inspector.
16
十二月癸丑，以中書侍郎蕭思話為青州刺史。 壬戌，前吳郡太守徐佩之謀反，及黨與皆伏誅。
On guichou of the twelfth month, Attendant of the Palace Library Xiao Sihua was made Qingzhou Inspector. On renxu, former Wu Prefect Xu Peizhi plotted rebellion; he and his accomplices were all executed.
17
四年春正月乙亥朔，曲赦都邑百里內。 辛巳，車駕親祠南郊。
On yihai, the new moon of the first month of spring in year 4, a partial amnesty was proclaimed within one hundred li of the capital. On xinsi, the imperial carriage personally performed sacrifice at the southern suburban altar.
18
二月乙卯，行幸丹徒，謁京陵。
On yimao of the second month, he traveled to Dantu and paid respects at the Jing Mausoleum.
19
三月丙子，詔曰：「丹徒桑梓綢繆，大業攸始，踐境永懷，觸感罔極。 昔漢章南巡，加恩元氏，況情義二三，有兼曩日。 思播遺澤，酬慰士民。 其蠲此縣今年租布，五歲刑以下皆悉原遣； 登城三戰及大將家，隨宜隱卹。 」丁亥，車駕還宮。 戊子，尚書右僕射鄭鮮之卒。 壬寅，禁斷夏至日五絲命縷之屬，富陽令諸葛闡之之議也。
On bingzi of the third month, an edict said: "Dantu is bound to me by ties of native place; the great enterprise began from there. Treading that soil, my feelings are everlasting; touched by it, my emotion knows no limit." Formerly Emperor Zhang of Han on his southern tour added favor to the Yuan clan; how much more when affection and obligation are doubled or tripled, as in days past. I wish to spread lingering bounty and repay and comfort the gentry and people. This county’s rent and cloth for this year are to be remitted; all punishments of five years or less are entirely pardoned and released. Those who fought three battles in the assault on the city and the households of great generals are to receive condolence and relief as appropriate. On dinghai, the imperial carriage returned to the palace. On wuzi, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Zheng Xianzhi died. On renyin, the use on the summer solstice of five-colored silk life-cords and the like was forbidden—this was the proposal of Fuyang Magistrate Zhuge Kan.
20
夏四月庚戌，以廷尉王徽之為交州刺史。
In summer, on gengxu of the fourth month, Director of the Court of Justice Wang Huizhi was made Jiaozhou Inspector.
21
五月壬午，中護軍王華卒。 京師疾疫，甲午，遣使存問，給醫藥； 死者若無家屬，賜以棺器。
On renwu of the fifth month, General of the Central Guard Wang Hua died. An epidemic struck the capital; on jiawu, envoys were sent to inquire after the people and provide medicine. If the dead had no family, coffins and burial goods were bestowed.
22
六月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。 庚申，以金紫光祿大夫殷穆為護軍將軍。
On guimao, the new moon of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse. On gengshen, Jinzi-guanglu Grand Master Yin Mu was made Protector of the Army.
23
五年春正月乙亥，詔曰：「朕恭承洪業，臨饗四海，風化未弘，治道多昧，求之人事，鑒寐惟憂。 加頃陰陽違序，旱疫成患，仰惟災戒，責深在予。 思所以側身剋念，議獄詳刑，上答天譴，下恤民瘼。 羣后百司，其各獻讜言，指陳得失，勿有所諱。 」甲申，車駕臨玄武館閱武。 戊子，京邑大火，遣使巡慰賑賜。
On yihai of the first month of spring in year 5, an edict said: "I respectfully receive the great enterprise and preside over feasting for the four seas; custom and transformation are not yet broadly spread, and the way of governance has many obscurities. Seeking it in human affairs, in waking and sleeping alike there is only worry." Moreover, yin and yang have lately been out of order, drought and plague have become calamities; looking up at these disaster warnings, the blame lies deep in me. I think how to turn my person and restrain my thoughts, deliberate on punishments and examine penalties, to answer Heaven’s reproof above and comfort the people’s afflictions below. All the hosts of ministers and the hundred offices are each to present loyal words, pointing out gains and losses—let nothing be concealed. On jiashen, the imperial carriage attended at the Black Tortoise Hall to review the troops. On wuzi, a great fire broke out in the capital; envoys were sent to tour, comfort, and grant relief.
24
夏四月己亥，以南蠻校尉蕭摹之為湘州刺史。 戊午，以始興太守徐豁為廣州刺史。
In summer, on jihai of the fourth month, Colonel of the Southern Man Xiao Muzhi was made Xiangzhou Inspector. On wuwu, Shixing Prefect Xu Huo was made Guangzhou Inspector.
25
五月己卯，以湘州刺史張邵為雍州刺史。
In the fifth month, on jimao, Xiangzhou Inspector Zhang Shao was appointed Yongzhou inspector.
26
六月庚戌，司徒王弘降為衞將軍、開府儀同三司。 京邑大水，乙卯，[4]遣使檢行賑贍。 以江夏內史程道惠為廣州刺史。
On gengxu of the sixth month, Grand Commandant Wang Hong was demoted to General Who Guards the Army with Opening Office equal to the Three Excellencies. After great floods in the capital, on yimao [4] envoys were dispatched to inspect the damage and distribute relief. Jiangxia interior administrator Cheng Daohui was appointed Guangzhou inspector.
27
秋八月壬戌，特進、左光祿大夫范泰卒。
In the eighth month of autumn, on renxu, Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace Fan Tai died.
28
冬十月甲辰，車駕於延賢堂聽訟。
In the tenth month of winter, on jiachen, the emperor heard cases at the Hall for Honoring the Worthy.
29
閏月癸未，以右軍司馬劉德武為豫州刺史。 辛卯，安陸公相周籍之為寧州刺史。
In the intercalary month, on guimao, Chief Clerk of the Right Army Liu Dewu was made Yuzhou inspector. On xinmao, Chancellor of the Duchy of Anling Zhou Jizhi was appointed Ningzhou inspector.
30
十二月庚寅，左光祿大夫、領軍將軍趙倫之卒。
On gengyin of the twelfth month, Left Grand Master of the Palace and General of the Palace Guard Zhao Lunzhi died.
31
是歲，天竺國遣使獻方物。
That year envoys from Tianzhu (India) arrived with tribute.
32
六年春正月辛丑，車駕親祠南郊。 癸丑，以驃騎將軍、荊州刺史彭城王義康為司徒、錄尚書事，領平北將軍、南徐州刺史。 [5]
On xinchou in the first month of spring, year 6, the emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburban altar. On guichou, General Who Acts as Commander-in-Chief and Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Pengcheng Yikang became Grand Commandant and Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, while retaining the posts of General Who Pacifies the North and Southern Xuzhou inspector. Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
33
三月丁巳，立皇子劭為皇太子。 戊午，大赦天下，賜文武位一等。 辛酉，以左衞將軍殷景仁為中領軍。
On dingsi of the third month, Prince Shao was installed as crown prince. On wuwu a general amnesty was declared and civil and military officials advanced one rank. On xinyou, General of the Left Guard Yin Jingren was appointed General of the Central Army.
34
夏四月癸亥，以尚書左僕射王敬弘為尚書令，丹陽尹臨川王義慶為尚書左僕射，吏部尚書江夷為尚書右僕射。
In the fourth month of summer, on guihai, Left Vice Director Wang Jinghong became Director of the Masters of Writing; Danyang governor Prince of Linchuan Yiqing became Left Vice Director; and Director of Personnel Jiang Yi became Right Vice Director.
35
五月壬辰朔，日有蝕之。 癸巳，以新除尚書令王敬弘為特進、左光祿大夫。 甲午，以撫軍司馬劉道濟為益州刺史。 乙卯，於雍州置馮翊郡。
On renchen, the new moon of the fifth month, there was a solar eclipse. On guisi the newly appointed Director Wang Jinghong was given the additional titles of Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace. On jiawu, Chief Clerk of the Pacifying Army Liu Daoji was appointed Yizhou inspector. On yimao the commandery of Pingyi was established within Yong Province.
36
七月己酉，以尚書左丞孔默之為廣州刺史。 是月，百濟王遣使獻方物。
In the seventh month, on jiyou, Left Vice Director Kong Mozhi was made Guangzhou inspector. That month the king of Baekje sent envoys with tribute.
37
九月戊午，於秦州置隴西、宋康二郡。
On wuwu of the ninth month, Longxi and Songkang commanderies were set up in Qin Province.
38
冬十月壬申，中領軍殷景仁丁艱去職。
In the tenth month of winter, on renshen, General of the Central Army Yin Jingren resigned to observe mourning.
39
十一月己丑朔，日有蝕之。
On jichou, the new moon of the eleventh month, there was a solar eclipse.
40
十二月丁亥，河南國、河西王遣使獻方物。 [6]
On dinghai of the twelfth month, Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys with tribute. Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
41
七年春正月癸巳，以吐谷渾慕容璝為征西將軍、沙州刺史。 是月，倭國王遣使獻方物。
On guisi in the first month of spring, year 7, Murong Gui of Tuyuhun was made General Who Campaigns in the West and inspector of Shazhou. That month the king of Wa (Japan) sent envoys with tribute.
42
三月戊子，遣右將軍到彥之北伐，水軍入河。 甲午，以前征虜司馬尹沖為司州刺史。 [7]甲寅，以前中領軍殷景仁為領軍將軍。
On wuzi of the third month, General of the Right Dao Yanzhi marched north while the fleet entered the Yellow River. On jiawu, former Chief Clerk for Campaigning against Barbarians Yin Chong was appointed Sizhou inspector. [7] On jiayin, former General of the Central Army Yin Jingren was restored as General of the Palace Guard.
43
夏四月癸未，訶羅單國遣使獻方物。
In the fourth month of summer, on guiwei, Heluodan sent envoys with tribute.
44
六月己卯，以冠軍將軍氐楊難當為秦州刺史。
On jimao of the sixth month, General Who Conquers Yang Nachang of the Di was made Qinzhou inspector.
45
秋七月戊子，索虜碻磝戍棄城走。 丙申，以平北諮議參軍甄法護為梁、南秦二州刺史。 戊戌，索虜滑臺戍棄城走。 甲寅，林邑國、訶羅陁國、師子國遣使獻方物。
In the seventh month of autumn, on wuzi, the Northern Wei garrison at Quepo abandoned the city and fled. On bingshen, Pacifying-the-North staff officer Zhen Fahu was appointed inspector of Liang and Southern Qin. On wuxu the Northern Wei garrison at Huatai abandoned the city and withdrew. On jiayin, Linyi, Heluotuo, and Shizi each sent envoys with tribute.
46
冬十月甲寅，罷南豫州并豫州。 以左將軍竟陵王義宣為徐州刺史。 戊午，立錢署，鑄四銖錢。 戊寅，金墉城為索虜所陷。
On jiayin of the tenth month of winter, Southern Yuzhou was abolished and absorbed into Yuzhou. General of the Left Prince of Jingling Yixuan was appointed Xuzhou inspector. On wuwu a government mint was established to cast four-zhu coins. On wuyin Jincheng fell to the Northern Wei.
47
十一月癸未，虎牢城復為索虜所陷。 壬辰，遣征南大將軍檀道濟北討，右將軍到彥之自滑臺奔退。
On guimao of the eleventh month, Hulao was lost again to the Northern Wei. On renchen General Who Campaigns in the South Tan Daoji marched north on campaign, while General of the Right Dao Yanzhi retreated in disorder from Huatai.
48
十二月辛酉，以南兗州刺史長沙王義欣為豫州刺史，司徒司馬吉翰為司州刺史。 乙亥，京邑火，延燒太社北牆。 兗州刺史竺靈秀有罪伏誅。
On xinyou of the twelfth month, Southern Xuzhou inspector Prince of Changsha Yixin became Yuzhou inspector, and Grand Commandant staff officer Ji Han became Sizhou inspector. On yihai a great fire in the capital spread to the north wall of the Grand Temple of Soil and Grain. Yanzhou Inspector Zhu Lingxiu, convicted of a crime, was executed.
49
八年春正月庚寅，於交州復立珠崖郡。 癸巳，以左軍將軍申宣為兗州刺史。 丁酉，征南大將軍檀道濟破索虜於東平壽張。 [8]
On gengyin in the first month of spring, year 8, Zhuyai Commandery was re-established in Jiaozhou. On guisi, General of the Left Army Shen Xuan was appointed Yanzhou inspector. On dingyou General Who Campaigns in the South Tan Daoji defeated the Northern Wei at Dongping Shouzhang. Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
50
二月乙卯，以平北司馬韋朗為青州刺史。 戊午，以尚書右僕射江夷為湘州刺史。 辛酉，滑臺為索虜所陷。 癸酉，征南大將軍檀道濟引軍還。 丁丑，青州刺史蕭思話棄城走。 以太子右衞率劉遵考為南兗州刺史。
On yimao of the second month, Chief Clerk of the Pacifying-the-North Army Wei Lang was made Qingzhou inspector. On wuwu, Right Vice Director Jiang Yi was appointed Xiangzhou inspector. On xinyou Huatai fell to the Northern Wei. On guiyou General Who Campaigns in the South Tan Daoji withdrew his army. On dingchou Qingzhou Inspector Xiao Sihua abandoned his post and fled. Leader of the Heir Apparent’s Right Guard Liu Zunkao was appointed Southern Xuzhou inspector.
51
三月甲申，車駕於延賢堂聽訟。 戊申，詔曰：「自頃軍役殷興，國用增廣，資儲不給，百度尚繁。 宜存簡約，以應事實。 內外可通共詳思，務令節儉。」
On jiashen of the third month, the emperor again heard cases at the Hall for Honoring the Worthy. On wushen an edict declared: "Military campaigns have lately multiplied and state expenses have grown; stores are insufficient and administration remains heavy." Let simplicity be preserved to match real needs. Within and without the court, let all deliberate together and strive for frugality."
52
夏四月甲寅，以衡陽王師阮萬齡為湘州刺史。 乙卯，以後軍參軍徐遵之為兗州刺史。
In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin, Prince of Hengyang Shiyuan Wanling was made Xiangzhou inspector. On yimao, Rear Army staff officer Xu Zunzhi was appointed Yanzhou inspector.
53
六月乙丑，大赦天下。 己卯，割江南及揚州晉陵郡屬南徐州，江北屬兗州。 以徐州刺史竟陵王義宣為南兗州刺史，司徒司馬吉翰為徐州刺史。
On yichou of the sixth month a general amnesty was proclaimed. On jimao lands south of the Yangtze and Jingling Commandery in Yang Province were placed under Southern Xuzhou, while the north bank was placed under Yan Province. Xuzhou inspector Prince of Jingling Yixuan became Southern Xuzhou inspector, and Grand Commandant staff officer Ji Han became Xuzhou inspector.
54
閏月庚子，詔曰：「自頃農桑惰業，遊食者眾，荒萊不闢，督課無聞。 一時水旱，便有罄匱，苟不深存務本，[9]豐給靡因。 郡守賦政方畿，縣宰親民之主，宜思奬訓，導以良規。 咸使肆力，地無遺利，耕蠶樹藝，各盡其力。 若有力田殊眾，歲竟條名列上。 」揚州旱。 乙巳，遣侍御史省獄訟，申調役。 丙午，以左軍諮議參軍劉道產為雍州刺史。
On gengzi of the intercalary month an edict said: "Agriculture and sericulture have lately grown slack; wanderers are many, wasteland lies unopened, and tax supervision goes unheard." When flood or drought strike in a season, want follows at once; unless the fundamental task is deeply preserved, [9] abundance will have no foundation. Prefects govern the capital region; magistrates are masters close to the people—they should encourage and instruct and guide them with sound rules. Let all be made to exert their strength so the land yields fully, and in plowing, sericulture, planting, and cultivation each gives his utmost. Those with exceptional success in farming are to be listed in detail and reported upward at year’s end." Yang Province suffered drought. On yisi attendant censors were sent to review prison cases and adjust corvée duties. On bingwu, Pacifying-the-Army staff officer Liu Daochan was appointed Yongzhou inspector.
55
秋八月甲辰，臨川王義慶解尚書僕射。 丁未，割豫州秦郡屬南兗州。
On jiachen of the eighth month, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing resigned as Vice Director of the Masters of Writing. On dingwei Qin Commandery in Yuzhou was transferred to Southern Xuzhou.
56
冬十二月，罷湘州還并荊州。
In the twelfth month of winter, Xiang Province was abolished and merged back into Jing Province.
57
九年春三月庚戌，衞將軍王弘進位太保，加中書監。 丁巳，征南大將軍、江州刺史檀道濟進位司空。
On gengxu in the third month of spring, year 9, General Who Guards the Army Wang Hong was promoted to Grand Preceptor with the additional post of Director of the Palace Library. On dingsi, General Who Campaigns in the South and Jiangzhou Inspector Tan Daoji was promoted to Minister of Works.
58
夏四月乙亥，以護軍將軍殷穆為特進、右光祿大夫，建昌縣公到彥之為護軍將軍。
In the fourth month of summer, on yihai, Protector of the Army Yin Mu became Special Grand Master and Right Grand Master of the Palace, and Marquis of Jianchang Dao Yanzhi became Protector of the Army.
59
五月壬申，中書監、錄尚書事、衞將軍、揚州刺史王弘薨。
On renshen of the fifth month, Director of the Palace Library, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, General Who Guards the Army, and Yangzhou Inspector Wang Hong died.
60
六月甲戌，以左軍諮議參軍申宣為青州刺史。 分青州置冀州。 戊寅，司徒、南徐州刺史彭城王義康改領揚州刺史。 己卯，以司徒參軍崔諲為冀州刺史。 壬午，以吐谷渾慕容延為平東將軍，[10]吐谷渾拾虔為平北將軍，吐谷渾輝伐為鎮軍將軍。 [11]癸未，詔曰：「益、梁、交、廣，境域幽遐，治宜物情，或多偏擁。 可更遣大使，巡求民瘼。 」置積射、強弩將軍官。 乙未，以征西將軍、沙州刺史吐谷渾慕容璝為征西大將軍、西秦河二州刺史、隴西王。 北秦州刺史氐楊難當加號征西將軍。 壬寅，以撫軍將軍、荊州刺史江夏王義恭為征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史，前將軍臨川王義慶為平西將軍、荊州刺史，南兗州刺史竟陵王義宣為中書監、中軍將軍，征虜將軍衡陽王義季為南徐州刺史。
On jiaxu, Pacifying-the-Army staff officer Shen Xuan was appointed Qingzhou inspector. Ji Province was carved out of Qing Province. On wuyin, Grand Commandant and Southern Xuzhou Inspector Prince of Pengcheng Yikang took over as Yangzhou inspector. On jimao, Grand Commandant staff officer Cui Yin was appointed Jizhou inspector. On renwu, Murong Yan of Tuyuhun was made General Who Pacifies the East, [10] Murong Shiqian General Who Pacifies the North, and Murong Huifa General Who Guards the Army. [11] On guimao an edict said: "Yi, Liang, Jiao, and Guang lie in distant borderlands; governance must suit local conditions, yet many officials rule with partial harshness." Grand envoys are again to be sent to tour the regions and investigate the people’s hardships." The posts of General of Strong Archers and General of Powerful Crossbows were established. On yiwei, General Who Campaigns in the West and Shazhou Inspector Murong Gui of Tuyuhun was promoted to Grand Marshal campaigning in the west, made inspector of Xi, Qin, and He, and enfeoffed as King of Longxi. Northern Qinzhou inspector Yang Nachang of the Di was given the additional title General Who Campaigns in the West. On renyin, Pacifying Army General and Jingzhou Inspector Prince of Jiangxia Yigong became General Who Campaigns in the North with Opening Office equal to the Three Excellencies and Southern Xuzhou inspector; former General Qian Prince of Linchuan Yiqing became General Who Pacifies the West and Jingzhou inspector; Southern Xuzhou inspector Prince of Jingling Yixuan became Director of the Palace Library and General of the Central Army; and General Who Campaigns against Barbarians Prince of Hengyang Yiji became Southern Xuzhou inspector.
61
秋七月戊辰，以尚書王仲德為鎮北將軍、徐州刺史。 庚午，以領軍將軍殷景仁為尚書僕射，太子詹事劉湛為領軍將軍。 壬申，河南國、河西王遣使獻方物。 [12]
In the seventh month of autumn, on wuchen, Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Zhongde was made General Who Guards the North and Xuzhou inspector. On gengwu, General of the Palace Guard Yin Jingren became Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Tutor of the Heir Apparent Liu Zhan became General of the Palace Guard. On renshen, Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys with tribute. Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
62
九月，妖賊趙廣寇益州，陷沒郡縣，州府討平之。
In the ninth month the rebel Zhao Guang raided Yizhou, seized commanderies and counties, and was suppressed by the provincial government.
63
冬十一月壬子，以少府甄法崇為益州刺史。 癸丑，於廣州立宋康郡。
On renzi of the eleventh month, Director of the Palace Treasury Zhen Fachong was appointed Yizhou inspector. On guichou Songkang Commandery was established in Guang Province.
64
十二月甲戌，以右軍參軍李秀之為交州刺史。 庚寅，立第五皇子紹為廬陵王，江夏王義恭子朗為南豐縣王。
On jiaxu of the twelfth month, Right Army staff officer Li Xiuzhi was appointed inspector of Jiao Province. On gengyin the fifth prince, Shao, was enfeoffed as Prince of Luling, and Lang, son of Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, as prince of Nanfeng county.
65
十年春正月甲寅，竟陵王義宣改封南譙王。 鎮北將軍、徐州刺史王仲德加領兗州刺史，淮南太守段宏為青州刺史。 己未，大赦天下。 孤老、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。 後將軍、豫州刺史長沙王義欣進號鎮軍將軍。
In the tenth year, on jiayin of the first spring month, Prince of Jingling Yixuan was redesignated Prince of Nanqiao. Pacifying-North general Wang Zhongde, already inspector of Xu, was also given Yan Province; Huainan administrator Duan Hong became inspector of Qing. On jiwei the court proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm. Each orphan or elderly person living alone, and anyone disabled by the six infirmities who could not support himself, received five hu of grain. Prince of Changsha Yixin, rear general and inspector of Yu, was promoted to General of the Army.
66
夏四月戊戌，青州刺史段宏加冀州刺史。 封陽縣侯蕭思話為梁、南秦二州刺史。
In summer’s fourth month, on wuxu, Qing inspector Duan Hong was also given Ji Province. Xiao Sihua, Marquis of Fengyang County, was appointed inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.
67
五月，林邑王遣使獻方物。
In the fifth month the king of Linyi (Champa) sent envoys with tribute.
68
六月乙亥，以前青州刺史韋朗為廣州刺史。 闍婆州訶羅單國遣使獻方物。
On yihai of the sixth month, former Qing inspector Wei Lang was made inspector of Guang. Heluodan in Campa sent envoys bearing tribute.
69
秋七月戊戌，曲赦益、梁、秦三州。 於益州立宋寧、宋興二郡。
On wuxu in the seventh autumn month, Yi, Liang, and Qin received a partial amnesty. Yi Province gained two new commanderies, Songning and Songxing.
70
八月丁丑，於青州立太原郡。 辛巳，護軍將軍到彥之卒。
On dingchou of the eighth month Taiyuan Commandery was set up within Qing Province. On xinsi Dao Yanzhi, Protector of the Army, passed away.
71
冬十一月，氐楊難當寇漢川。 丁未，梁州刺史甄法護棄城走，難當據有梁州。
That winter, in the eleventh month, the Di leader Yang Nadu attacked Hanzhuan. On dingwei Liang inspector Zhen Fahu abandoned his post and fled, and Nadu took possession of Liang.
72
十一年春正月，亡命馬大玄羣黨數百人寇泰山，[13]州郡討平之。
In the eleventh year’s first spring month, the fugitive Ma Daxuan led several hundred followers in a raid on Mount Tai; [13] provincial and commandery forces suppressed and pacified them.
73
二月癸酉，以交阯太守李耽之為交州刺史。
On guiyou of the second month, Jiaozhi administrator Li Danzhi became inspector of Jiao.
74
夏四月，梁、秦二州刺史蕭思話破氐楊難當，梁州平。
In summer’s fourth month Xiao Sihua, inspector of Liang and Southern Qin, defeated the Di leader Yang Nadu and restored order in Liang.
75
五月丁卯，曲赦梁、南秦二州劍閣北。 戊寅，以大沮渠茂虔為征西大將軍、涼州刺史。
On dingmao of the fifth month a partial amnesty was declared for Liang and Southern Qin north of Jian’ge. On wuyin Juqu Maoqian of Northern Liang was appointed Grand General campaigning west and inspector of Liang.
76
是月，京邑大水。
That month severe floods struck the capital.
77
六月丁未，省魏郡。
On dingwei of the sixth month Wei Commandery was abolished.
78
是歲，林邑國、扶南國、訶羅單國遣使獻方物。
That year envoys from Linyi, Funan, and Heluodan arrived with tribute.
79
十二年春正月辛酉，大赦天下。 辛未，車駕親祠南郊。 癸酉，封黃龍國主馮弘為燕王。
On xinyou in the twelfth year’s first spring month the court proclaimed a general amnesty. On xinwei the emperor personally sacrificed at the southern suburban altar. On guiyou Feng Hong of the Yellow Dragon state received the enfeoffment of Prince of Yan.
80
夏四月乙酉，[14]尚書僕射殷景仁加中護軍。 丙辰，詔曰：「周宗以寧，實由多士，漢室之隆，亦資得人。 朕寐寤樂賢，為日已久，而則哲難階，明揚莫効。 用令遺才在野，管庫虛朝，永懷前載，慚德深矣。 夫舉爾所知，宣尼之篤訓，貢士任官，先代之成准。 便可宣敕內外，各有薦舉。 當依方銓引，以觀厥用。 」是夜，京都地震。
In summer’s fourth month, on yiyou, [14] Masters of Writing vice director Yin Jingren was also made General of the Central Army. On bingchen an edict declared: "The Zhou house found peace through its many officers, and the Han rose in glory by winning able men. I have long dreamed and waked with joy in worthy men, yet true discernment remains beyond reach and my calls to elevate talent have borne no fruit. Talented men still wander outside office while the court’s storehouses stand empty; pondering the examples of antiquity, I am deeply ashamed of my own virtue. "Recommend those you know" is Confucius’s earnest teaching; presenting scholars and appointing them to office is the settled standard of former ages. Let an edict go forth within and without the court, and let every office submit recommendations. They shall be assessed and advanced according to their measure, that we may see what service they can render." That night the capital was struck by an earthquake.
81
六月，丹陽、淮南、吳興、義興大水，京邑乘船。 己酉，以徐豫南兗三州、會稽宣城二郡米數百萬斛賜五郡遭水民。 是月，斷酒。 師子國遣使獻方物。
In the sixth month Danyang, Huainan, Wuxing, and Yixing were inundated, and in the capital people went about by boat. On jiyou several million hu of grain from Xu, Yu, and Southern Yan and from Kuaiji and Xuancheng were distributed to the people of the five flood-stricken commanderies. That month the court banned the sale of wine. The Lion Country (Sri Lanka) sent envoys with tribute.
82
秋七月辛酉，[15]闍婆娑達國、扶南國並遣使獻方物。
On xinyou in the seventh autumn month, [15] Campasataka and Funan each sent envoys with tribute.
83
八月壬申，於益州立南晉壽、南新巴、北巴西三郡。 [16]乙亥，原遭水郡諸逋負。
On renshen of the eighth month Yi Province gained the three new commanderies of Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi. [16] On yihai all outstanding levies in the flood-stricken commanderies were forgiven.
84
九月，蜀郡賊張尋為寇。
In the ninth month the outlaw Zhang Xun of Shu Commandery took up arms.
85
冬十一月，以右軍行參軍苟道覆為交州刺史。
In the eleventh winter month Right Army acting staff officer Gou Daofu was appointed inspector of Jiao.
86
十三年春正月癸丑，上有疾，不朝會。
On guichou in the thirteenth year’s first spring month the emperor fell ill and ceased holding court.
87
三月己未，司空、江州刺史檀道濟有罪伏誅。 庚申，大赦天下。 以中軍將軍南譙王義宣為鎮南將軍、江州刺史。
On jiwei of the third month Tan Daoji, Minister of Works and inspector of Jiang, was found guilty and put to death. On gengshen the court proclaimed a general amnesty. Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, central army general, was made Pacifying-South general and inspector of Jiang.
88
夏五月戊辰，鎮北將軍、徐兗二州刺史王仲德進號鎮北大將軍。 庚辰，以征北司馬王方俳為兗州刺史。
On wuchen in the fifth summer month pacifying-north general Wang Zhongde, inspector of Xu and Yan, was promoted to Pacifying-North Grand General. On gengchen campaigning-north staff officer Wang Fangpai was appointed inspector of Yan.
89
六月，高麗國、武都王遣使獻方物。
In the sixth month Goguryeo and the King of Wudu sent envoys with tribute.
90
八月庚寅，尚書僕射、中護軍殷景仁改為護軍將軍。
On gengyin of the eighth month Yin Jingren relinquished his posts as vice director and central army general and became Protector of the Army.
91
九月癸丑，立第二皇子濬為始興王，第三皇子駿為武陵王。
On guichou of the ninth month the second prince, Jun, was enfeoffed as Prince of Shixing and the third prince, Jun, as Prince of Wuling.
92
十四年春正月辛卯，車駕親祠南郊，大赦天下。 文武賜位一等； 孤老、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。
On xinmao in the fourteenth year’s first spring month the emperor sacrificed at the southern suburb and proclaimed a general amnesty. Civil and military officials were each advanced one rank in status; and each orphan or elderly person living alone, and anyone disabled by the six infirmities who could not support himself, received five hu of grain.
93
二月壬子，以步兵校尉劉真道為梁、南秦二州刺史。 [17]
On renzi of the second month footsoldier colonel Liu Zhendao was appointed inspector of Liang and Southern Qin. Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
94
夏四月丁未，以輔國將軍周籍之為益州刺史。
On dingwei in the fourth summer month state-assisting general Zhou Jizhi was made inspector of Yi.
95
秋八月戊午，以尚書金部郎中徐森之為交州刺史。
On wuwu in the eighth autumn month Xu Senzhi of the Masters of Writing gold section was appointed inspector of Jiao.
96
冬十二月辛酉，停賀雪。 河南國、河西王、訶羅單國並遣使獻方物。 [18]
On xinyou of the twelfth winter month the court suspended the snow-congratulation ceremony. Henan, the King of Hexi, and Heluodan each sent envoys with tribute. Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
97
十五年春二月丁未，以平東將軍吐谷渾慕容延為鎮西將軍、秦河二州刺史。
On dingwei in the fifteenth year’s second spring month Murong Yan of Tuyuhun, eastern pacifying general, was made western pacifying general and inspector of Qin and He.
98
夏四月甲辰，燕王弘遣使獻方物。 [19]立皇太子妃殷氏，賜王公以下各有差。 己巳，以倭國王珍為安東將軍。
On jiachen in the fourth summer month Prince of Yan Hong sent envoys with tribute. [19] The crown prince’s consort of the Yin clan was installed, and kings, dukes, and officials below them received graded gifts. On jisi the king of Wa (Japan), Zhen, was appointed Pacifying-East general.
99
五月己丑，特進、右光祿大夫殷穆卒。 辛卯，鎮北大將軍、徐州刺史王仲德卒。 壬辰，以右衞將軍劉遵考為徐、兗二州刺史。
On jichou special grand master Yin Mu, Right Grand Master of the Palace, passed away. On xinmao pacifying-north grand general Wang Zhongde, inspector of Xu, died. On renchen right guard general Liu Zunkao was appointed inspector of Xu and Yan.
100
秋七月辛未，地震。 甲戌，以陳、南頓二郡太守徐循為寧州刺史。
On xinwei in the seventh autumn month an earthquake struck. On jiaxu Chen and Nandun administrator Xu Xun was made inspector of Ning.
101
八月辛丑，以左衞將軍趙伯符為徐、兗二州刺史。 甲寅，以始興內史陸徽為廣州刺史。 丁巳，以兗州刺史王方俳為青、冀二州刺史。
On xinchou of the eighth month left guard general Zhao Bofu was appointed inspector of Xu and Yan. On jiayin Shixing administrator Lu Hui became inspector of Guang. On dingsi Yan inspector Wang Fangpai was given Qing and Ji as well.
102
是歲，武都王、河南國、高麗國、倭國、扶南國、林邑國並遣使獻方物。
That year the King of Wudu, Henan, Goguryeo, Wa (Japan), Funan, and Linyi all sent tribute missions.
103
十六年春正月戊寅，車駕於北郊閱武。 庚寅，司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史彭城王義康進位大將軍，領司徒，餘如故。 征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭進位司空，刺史如故。 特進、左光祿大夫王敬弘開府儀同三司。 癸巳，復分荊州置湘州。
On wuyin in the sixteenth year’s first spring month the emperor reviewed troops at the northern suburb. On gengyin Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Minister over the Masses, recorder of the Masters of Writing, and Yang inspector, was promoted to Grand General while retaining the ministry and his other posts. Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, campaigning-north general with credentials equal to the Three Dukes and inspector of Southern Yan, was promoted to Minister of Works and kept his inspectorship. Wang Jinghong, Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of the Palace, received an opening office equal to the Three Dukes. On guisi Jing was again partitioned to create Xiang Province.
104
二月己亥，以南徐州刺史衡陽王義季為安西將軍、荊州刺史。 丁未，以始興王濬為湘州刺史。 癸亥，割梁州之巴西梓潼南宕渠南漢中、南秦州之南安懷寧凡六郡，[20]屬益州。 分長沙江夏郡立巴陵郡，屬湘州。
On jihai of the second month Prince of Hengyang Yiji, inspector of Southern Xu, was made western pacifying general and inspector of Jing. On dingwei Prince of Shixing Jun was appointed inspector of Xiang. On guihai six commanderies—Baxi, Zitong, Southern Dangqu, and Southern Hanzhong from Liang and Nan’an and Huaining from Southern Qin [20]—were detached and assigned to Yi. Baling Commandery was carved out of Changsha and Jiangxia and placed under Xiang.
105
夏四月丁巳，以鎮南將軍、江州刺史南譙王義宣為征北將軍、南徐州刺史。 平西將軍臨川王義慶為衞將軍、江州刺史。
On dingsi in the fourth summer month Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, pacifying-south general and Jiang inspector, became campaigning-north general and inspector of Southern Xu. Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, western pacifying general, was made Guard general and inspector of Jiang.
106
六月己酉，隴西吐谷渾慕容延改封河南王。 癸丑，以吐谷渾拾寅為平西將軍，吐谷渾繁暱為撫軍將軍。
On jiyou of the sixth month Murong Yan of Longxi Tuyuhun was redesignated King of Henan. On guichou Murong Shibin of Tuyuhun was made western pacifying general and Murong Fanni pacifying-army general.
107
秋八月庚子，立第四皇子鑠為南平王。
On gengzi in the eighth autumn month the fourth prince, Shuo, was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping.
108
閏月乙未，鎮軍將軍、豫州刺史長沙王義欣薨。 戊戌，復分豫州之淮南為南豫州。 癸卯，以左衞將軍劉遵考為豫州刺史。 戊申，以湘州刺史始興王濬為南豫州刺史，武陵王駿為湘州刺史。
On yiwei of the intercalary month Prince of Changsha Yixin, army general and Yu inspector, died. On wuxu Huainan was again split from Yu to form Southern Yu Province. On guimao left guard general Liu Zunkao was appointed inspector of Yu. On wushen Prince of Shixing Jun exchanged Xiang for Southern Yu, and Prince of Wuling Jun took Xiang in his place.
109
冬十二月乙亥，皇太子冠，大赦天下。
On yihai in the twelfth winter month the crown prince came of age in the capping rite and the court proclaimed a general amnesty.
110
是歲，武都王、河南王、林邑國、高麗國並遣使獻方物。
That year the kings of Wudu and Henan, together with Linyi and Goguryeo, sent tribute missions.
111
十七年夏四月戊午朔，日有蝕之。
In the seventeenth year’s fourth summer month, on the new moon of wuwu, a solar eclipse occurred.
112
五月癸巳，領軍將軍劉湛母憂去職。
On guisi of the fifth month palace guard army general Liu Zhan resigned to observe mourning for his mother.
113
秋七月壬寅，以征虜諮議參軍杜驥為青州刺史。 壬子，皇后袁氏崩。
In the seventh month of autumn, on renyin, Du Ji, consulting adviser to the General Who Campaigns against Invaders, was appointed Qingzhou inspector. On renzi, Empress Yuan (the Yuan empress) died.
114
八月，徐、兗、青、冀四州大水，己未，遣使檢行賑卹。
In the eighth month great floods struck Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji; on jiwei envoys were dispatched to inspect the damage and distribute relief.
115
九月壬子，葬元皇后於長寧陵。
On renzi of the ninth month the Yuan empress was interred at Changning Mausoleum.
116
冬十月戊午，前丹陽尹劉湛有罪，及同黨伏誅。 大赦天下，文武賜爵一級。 以大將軍、領司徒、錄尚書、揚州刺史彭城王義康為江州刺史，大將軍如故。 以司空、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為司徒、錄尚書事。 戊寅，衞將軍臨川王義慶以本號為南兗州刺史，尚書僕射、護軍將軍殷景仁為揚州刺史，僕射如故。
In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu, former Danyang prefect Liu Zhan was found guilty; he and his faction were put to death. A general amnesty was declared, and civil and military officials advanced one noble rank. Prince of Pengcheng Yikang—grand general, concurrent grand secretary, supervisor of the Masters of Writing, and Yangzhou inspector—was made Jiangzhou inspector while keeping his grand general title. Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, minister of works and Southern Yanzhou inspector, became grand secretary and supervisor of the Masters of Writing. On wuyin, General of the Guard Prince of Linchuan Yiqing remained Southern Yanzhou inspector under his existing title; Vice Director Yin Jingren, also general who protects the army, became Yangzhou inspector while keeping the vice directorship.
117
十一月丙戌，以尚書劉義融為領軍將軍，祕書監徐湛之為中護軍。 丁亥，詔曰：「前所給揚、南徐二州百姓田糧種子，兗、兩豫、青、徐諸州比年所寬租穀應督入者，悉除半。 今年有不收處，[21]都原之。 凡諸逋債，優量申減。 又州郡估稅，所在市調，多有煩刻。 山澤之利，猶或禁斷； 役召之品，遂及稚弱。 諸如此比，傷治害民。 自今咸依法令，務盡優允。 如有不便，即依事別言，不得苟趣一時，以乖隱卹之旨。 主者明加宣下，稱朕意焉。 」癸丑，尚書僕射、揚州刺史殷景仁卒。
On bingxu of the eleventh month, Director Liu Yirong was appointed general of the central army and Palace Library supervisor Xu Tanzhi general of the central household guards. On dinghai an edict declared: "Field grain and seed earlier granted to Yang and Southern Xu, and half the rent grain from Yan, both Yu, Qing, and Xu that recent tax relief still required to be forwarded, are all remitted." Where the harvest fails this year, [21] all obligations are cancelled outright. Every outstanding debt is to be leniently reviewed and reduced. Provincial and commandery appraisal taxes and local market dues are also often burdensome and severe. Revenue from mountains and marshes is still barred in some districts; and corvée categories even extend to the very young. Such abuses damage good rule and hurt the common people. Henceforth all are to follow statute and law, doing their utmost to grant leniency and ease. Where something will not work, report it on its merits; do not chase short-term expedients and betray the intent of compassionate governance. Let responsible officials proclaim this clearly throughout the realm and make my will known. On guichou, Vice Director and Yangzhou inspector Yin Jingren died.
118
十二月癸亥，以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射。 [22]戊辰，以南豫州刺史始興王濬為揚州刺史，湘州刺史武陵王駿為南豫州刺史，南平王鑠為湘州刺史。
On guihai of the twelfth month, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Wang Qiu was appointed vice director of the Masters of Writing. [22] On wuchen, Prince of Shixing Jun moved from Southern Yuzhou to Yangzhou; Prince of Wuling Jun took Southern Yuzhou from Xiangzhou; and Prince of Nanping Shuo became Xiangzhou inspector.
119
是歲，武都王、河南王、百濟國遣使獻方物。
That year the kings of Wudu and Henan and the state of Baekje sent envoys with tribute.
120
十八年春二月乙卯，以豫章太守庾登之為江州刺史。
In the second month of spring, year 18, on yimao, Yuzhang prefect Yu Dengzhi was appointed Jiangzhou inspector.
121
夏五月壬午，[23]衞將軍南兗州刺史臨川王義慶、征北將軍南徐州刺史南譙王義宣並開府儀同三司。 癸巳，於交州置宋熙郡。 是月，沔水泛溢。
In the fifth month of summer, on renwu, [23] Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, general of the guard and Southern Yanzhou inspector, and Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, general who campaigns north and Southern Xuzhou inspector, both received opening office equal to the Three Excellencies. On guisi the commandery of Songxi was set up in Jiao Province. That month the Han River flooded.
122
六月戊辰，遣使巡行賑贍。 辛未，領軍將軍劉義融卒。
On wuchen of the sixth month envoys were dispatched to tour the districts and distribute relief. On xinwei, general of the central army Liu Yirong died.
123
秋七月戊戌，以徐、兗二州刺史趙伯符為領軍將軍。
On wuxu in the seventh month of autumn, Xuzhou and Yanzhou inspector Zhao Bofu was appointed general of the central army.
124
冬十月辛亥，以巴東、建平二郡太守臧質為徐、兗二州刺史。 乙卯，省南徐州之南燕、濮陽、南廣平郡。
On xinhai of the tenth month of winter, Zang Zhi, prefect of Badong and Jianping, became Xuzhou and Yanzhou inspector. On yimao the Southern Xuzhou commanderies Nanyan, Puyang, and Nanguangping were abolished.
125
十一月戊子，尚書僕射王球卒。 [24]己亥，以丹陽尹孟顗為尚書僕射。
On wuzi of the eleventh month, Vice Director Wang Qiu died. [24] On jihai, Danyang prefect Meng Yi was appointed vice director of the Masters of Writing.
126
氐楊難當又寇漢川。 十二月癸亥，遣龍驤將軍裴方明與梁、秦二州刺史劉真道討之。 是月，[25]晉寧太守爨松子反叛，寧州刺史徐循討平之。
Yang Nachang of the Di again invaded Hanzhong. On guihai of the twelfth month, Dragon Cavalry General Pei Fangming and Liang-Qin inspector Liu Zhendao were sent to suppress him. That month, [25] Jinning prefect Cuan Songzi rose in rebellion; Ningzhou inspector Xu Xun put down the revolt.
127
是歲，肅特國、高麗國、蘇靡黎國、林邑國並遣使獻方物。
That year envoys from Sute, Goguryeo, Sumali, and Linyi arrived with tribute.
128
十九年正月乙巳，詔曰：「夫所因者本，聖哲之遠教； 本立化成，斆學之為貴。 故詔以三德，崇以四術，用能納諸義方，致之軌度。 盛王聖世，[26]咸必由之。 永初受命，憲章弘遠，將陶鈞庶品，混一殊風，有詔典司，大啟庠序，而頻遘屯夷，未及修建。 永瞻前猷，思敷鴻烈。 今方隅乂寧，戎夏慕嚮，廣訓冑子，實維時務。 便可式遵成規，闡揚景業。」
On yisi of the first month, year 19, an edict declared: "What is founded upon is the root—the far-off instruction of sages and worthies; once the root stands firm, culture takes shape through teaching, and devoted study is prized above all. Hence the three virtues were enjoined and the four arts exalted, enabling every proper path to be gathered in and brought to standard. In ages of great kings and holy rulers, [26] none failed to walk this way. At the founding of Yongchu the laws were proclaimed on a grand scale, aiming to shape all ranks in the crucible and unify disparate customs; edicts ordered the responsible offices to open schools widely, yet repeated calamities left construction unfinished. Ever looking back to the plans of old, we long to extend that magnificent enterprise. Now the realm is tranquil, north and south look to the court, and to train the crown princes broadly is truly the urgent business of the time. Let the court at once follow the settled precedent and raise high this splendid undertaking."
129
夏四月甲戌，以久疾愈，始奉礿祠，[27]大赦天下。
On jiaxu of the fourth month of summer, recovered from a long illness, he offered the yue ancestral rites for the first time; [27] a general amnesty followed.
130
五月庚寅，梁秦二州刺史劉真道、龍驤將軍裴方明破氐楊難當，仇池平。
On gengyin of the fifth month, Liu Zhendao and Pei Fangming crushed the Di leader Yang Nachang and pacified Chou Pool.
131
閏月，京邑雨水； 丁巳，遣使巡行賑卹。
In the intercalary month the capital was inundated by rain; on dingsi envoys were sent to inspect the damage and distribute relief.
132
六月壬午，以大沮渠無諱為征西大將軍、涼州刺史。
On renwu of the sixth month, Juqu Wuhui of Northern Liang was appointed general who campaigns in the west and Liangzhou inspector.
133
秋七月，以梁、秦二州刺史劉真道為雍州刺史，龍驤將軍裴方明為梁、南秦二州刺史。 甲戌晦，日有蝕之。
In the seventh month of autumn, Liu Zhendao moved from Liang and Qin to Yongzhou, and Pei Fangming became inspector of Liang and Southern Qin. At the end of jiaxu month-day, the sun was eclipsed.
134
冬十月甲申，芮芮國遣使獻方物。 己亥，以晉寧太守周萬歲為寧州刺史。
On jiashen of the tenth month of winter, Rouran sent envoys with tribute. On jihai, Jinning prefect Zhou Wansui was appointed Ningzhou inspector.
135
十二月丙申，詔曰：「冑子始集，學業方興。 自微言泯絕，逝將千祀，感事思人，意有慨然。 奉聖之胤，可速議繼襲。 於先廟地，特為營造，依舊給祠置令，四時饗祀。 闕里往經寇亂，黌校殘毀，并下魯郡修復學舍，採召生徒。 昔之賢哲及一介之善，猶或衞其丘壟，禁其芻牧，況尼父德表生民，功被百代，而墳塋荒蕪，荊棘弗翦。 可蠲墓側數戶，以掌洒掃。 」魯郡上民孔景等五戶居近孔子墓側，蠲其課役，供給洒掃，并種松栢六百株。
On bingshen of the twelfth month an edict said: "The crown princes are gathering and learning is rising anew. Since the subtle teachings fell silent, nearly a millennium has gone by; reflecting on the affair, we think of the man and cannot but sigh. Let the line of the Sage honored in sacrifice be quickly chosen for succession. On the ground of the former shrine let a temple be specially erected; as before, provide for sacrifice, appoint a custodian, and offer seasonal rites in the four seasons. Que Li has endured raids and disorder; its academy lies in ruins—order Lu Commandery likewise to restore the school buildings and enroll students. Men of old, however slight their merit, might still have their mounds protected and grazing forbidden—how much more Confucius, whose virtue illumines the age and whose merit spans a hundred generations, while his grave lies desolate and thorns go untrimmed. Exempt several households beside the tomb to tend sprinkling and sweeping. Five leading households of Lu Commandery, including Kong Jing, living beside Confucius’s tomb, were exempted from tax and corvée, supplied for upkeep, and planted six hundred pine and cypress trees.
136
是歲，婆皇國遣使獻方物。
That year envoys from Pohuang arrived with tribute.
137
二十年春正月，於臺城東西開萬春、千秋二門。
In the first month of spring, year 20, the Wan Spring and Thousand Autumns gates were opened on the east and west of the Terrace City.
138
二月甲戌，江州刺史庾登之為中護軍。 庚申，[28]以廬陵王紹為江州刺史。 仇池為索虜所沒。 甲申，車駕於白下閱武。
On jiaxu of the second month, Jiangzhou inspector Yu Dengzhi became general of the central household guards. On gengshen, [28] Prince of Luling Shao was appointed Jiangzhou inspector. Chou Pool fell to the Northern Wei. On jiashen the emperor reviewed the army at Baixia.
139
三月辛亥，安西將軍、荊州刺史衡陽王義季進號征西大將軍。 以巴西、梓潼二郡太守申坦為梁、南秦二州刺史。
On xinhai of the third month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, general who pacifies the west and Jingzhou inspector, was promoted to general who campaigns in the west. Shen Tan, prefect of Baxi and Zitong, was appointed inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.
140
夏四月甲午，立第六皇子誕為廣陵王。
On jiawu of the fourth month of summer, the sixth prince Dan was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangling.
141
五月癸丑，中護軍庾登之卒。
On guichou of the fifth month, general of the central household guards Yu Dengzhi died.
142
秋七月癸丑，以楊文德為征西將軍、北秦州刺史，封武都王。 辛酉，以南蠻校尉蕭思話為雍州刺史。 甲子，前雍州刺史劉真道、梁南秦二州刺史裴方明有罪，下獄死。
On guichou of the seventh month of autumn, Yang Wende was made general who campaigns in the west and Northern Qinzhou inspector and enfeoffed as king of Wudu. On xinyou, Colonel of the Southern Man Xiao Sihua was appointed Yongzhou inspector. On jiazi, former Yongzhou inspector Liu Zhendao and Liang-Southern Qin inspector Pei Fangming were found guilty, imprisoned, and died in custody.
143
八月癸未，以廷尉陶愍祖為廣州刺史。
On guiwei of the eighth month, Commandant of Punishments Tao Minzu was appointed Guangzhou inspector.
144
冬十二月庚午，以始興內史檀和之為交州刺史。 壬午，詔曰：「國以民為本，民以食為天。 故一夫輟稼，饑者必及。 倉廩既實，禮節以興。 自頃在所貧罄，家無宿積。 賦役暫偏，則人懷愁墊； 歲或不稔，而病乏比室。 誠由政德弗孚，以臻斯弊； 抑亦耕桑未廣，地利多遺。 宰守微化導之方，萌庶忘勤分之義。 永言弘濟，明發載懷。 雖制令亟下，終莫懲勸，而坐望滋殖，庸可致乎。 有司其班宣舊條，務盡敦課。 遊食之徒，咸令附業，考覈勤惰，行其誅賞，觀察能殿，嚴加黜陟。 古者躬耕帝籍，敬供粢盛，仰瞻前王，思遵令典。 便可量處千畝，考卜元辰。 朕當親率百辟，致禮郊甸，庶幾誠素，將被斯民。」
On gengwu of the twelfth month of winter, Shixing interior secretary Tan Hezhi was appointed Jiaozhou inspector. On renwu an edict declared: "The state rests on the people; the people rest on grain. When a single farmer leaves the fields, hunger reaches his neighbors. Full granaries give rise to ritual and decorum. Lately every district is destitute and homes hold no reserve grain. When levies fall unevenly, the people sink into misery; when harvests fail, sickness and want spread from door to door. This indeed comes of a government whose virtue has not won the people’s trust; yet also because farming and sericulture are not broad enough and much of the land’s yield goes untapped. Magistrates neglect to teach and guide, and the people forget their share of honest toil. We speak constantly of relieving the people, and at daybreak the thought is still upon us. Edicts rain down yet no one is moved to reform—still we expect abundance to appear of itself; how can that happen? Let the responsible offices publish the old statutes and press hard on earnest supervision and instruction. Vagrants are to be made to settle into work; diligence and idleness are to be checked, rewards and punishments enforced, competence in office observed, and promotion and dismissal applied rigorously. Ancient kings plowed the sacred fields themselves and furnished the sacrificial grain; looking to their example, we mean to follow that ordinance. Let a thousand mu be marked out and the propitious day chosen by divination. I shall lead the hundred officials in person to perform the suburban rites, so that honest simplicity may reach the people."
145
是歲，河西國、高麗國、百濟國、倭國並遣使獻方物。
That year envoys from Hexi, Goguryeo, Baekje, and Wa arrived with tribute.
146
是歲，諸州郡水旱傷稼，民大饑。 遣使開倉賑卹，給賜糧種。
That year floods and droughts ruined the harvest across many provinces and commanderies, and famine gripped the people. Envoys were dispatched to open the storehouses, grant relief, and distribute grain and seed.
147
二十一年春正月己亥，南徐、南豫州、揚州之浙江西，[29]並禁酒。 大赦天下。 諸逋債在十九年以前，一切原除。 去歲失收者，疇量申減。 尤弊之處，遣使就郡縣隨宜賑卹。 凡欲附農，而種糧匱乏者，並加給貸。 營千畝諸統司役人，賜布各有差。 戊午，衞將軍臨川王義慶薨。 辛酉，以太子詹事劉義宗為南兗州刺史。
On jihai of the first month of spring, year 21, Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and the lands west of the Zhe River in Yang Province [29] were placed under a general ban on wine. A general amnesty was declared for the empire. Every outstanding debt dating to before the nineteenth year is cancelled outright. Where last year’s harvest failed, reductions are to be surveyed field by field and reported. In the worst-afflicted districts, envoys are dispatched to the commanderies and counties to distribute relief as local conditions require. Anyone wishing to settle on the land but short of seed is to receive extra grain on loan. Corvée workers on the thousand-mu estates receive cloth stipends graded by rank. On wuwu, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, general of the guard, died. On xinyou, crown prince household steward Liu Yizong was appointed Southern Xuzhou inspector.
148
二月庚午，以領軍將軍趙伯符為豫州刺史。 己丑，司徒、錄尚書事江夏王義恭進位太尉，領司徒。 庚寅，以右衞將軍沈演之為中領軍。 辛卯，立第七皇子宏為建平王。 甲午，以廣陵王誕為南兗州刺史。
In the second month, on gengwu, household guards general Zhao Bofu became Yuzhou inspector. On jichou, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong—minister over the masses and supervisor of the Masters of Writing—was promoted to grand commandant while keeping the ministry of works. On gengyin, right guard general Shen Yanzhi was appointed general of the central household guards. On xinmao, the seventh prince Hong was enfeoffed as Prince of Jianping. On jiawu, Prince of Guangling Dan was appointed Southern Yanzhou inspector.
149
夏四月，晉陵延陵民徐耕以米千斛助卹饑民。
In the fourth summer month, Xu Geng of Yanling in Jinling donated a thousand hu of grain to feed the hungry.
150
五月壬戌，以尚書何尚之為中護軍，諮議參軍劉道錫為廣州刺史。
On renxu of the fifth month, He Shangzhi of the Masters of Writing became general who protects the army, and consulting adviser Liu Daoxi became Guangzhou inspector.
151
六月，連雨水。 丁亥，詔曰：「霖雨彌日，水潦為患，百姓積儉，易致乏匱。 二縣官長及營署部司，各隨統檢實，給其柴米，必使周悉。」
The sixth month brought unbroken rain. On dinghai an edict declared: "Prolonged rain has brought floods; after years of thrift the people are quickly reduced to need." Magistrates of the two counties and camp and office supervisors are to check their jurisdictions, verify needs, and issue firewood and grain until every household is provided for."
152
秋七月丁酉，揚州刺史始興王濬加中軍將軍，南豫州刺史武陵王駿加撫軍將軍。 [30]乙巳，詔曰：「比年穀稼傷損，淫亢成災，亦由播殖之宜，尚有未盡。 南徐、兗、豫及揚州浙江西屬郡，自今悉督種麥，以助闕乏。 速運彭城下邳郡見種，委刺史貸給。 徐、豫土多稻田，而民間專務陸作，可符二鎮，履行舊陂，相率修立，并課墾闢，使及來年。 凡諸州郡，皆令盡勤地利，勸導播殖，蠶桑麻紵，各盡其方，不得但奉行公文而已。」
On dingyou in the seventh autumn month, Prince of Shixing Jun, Yangzhou inspector, was made general of the central army, and Prince of Wuling Jun, Southern Yuzhou inspector, general who pacifies the army. [30] On yisi an edict declared: "Harvests have suffered in recent years and drought has become a calamity—partly because sowing seasons are still not fully kept." Southern Xu, Yan, Yu, and the Yangzhou commanderies west of the Zhe are henceforth to plant wheat under supervision to fill the shortfall. Seed stock in Pengcheng and Xiapi is to be rushed forward and lent out by the provincial inspectors. Xu and Yu are rich in paddies yet farmers favor dry crops; the two frontier commands are ordered to restore old dikes jointly, open new fields, and finish the work within the year. Every province and commandery must exploit its soil to the full, promote planting, and raise silk, hemp, and ramie each in its season—not merely shuffle paperwork."
153
八月戊辰，征西大將軍、荊州刺史衡陽王義季為征北大將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史，征北將軍、南徐州刺史南譙王義宣為車騎將軍、荊州刺史。 [31]南兗州刺史廣陵王誕為南徐州刺史。
On wuchen of the eighth month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji became northern campaigning general with opening office equal to the Three Excellencies and Southern Xuzhou inspector; Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan became general of chariots and cavalry and Jingzhou inspector. [31] Prince of Guangling Dan moved from Southern Yanzhou to Southern Xuzhou.
154
九月甲辰，以大沮渠安周為征西將軍、涼州刺史，封河西王。
On jiachen of the ninth month, Juqu Anzhou of Northern Liang was made western campaigning general and Liangzhou inspector and enfeoffed king of Hexi.
155
冬十月己卯，以左軍將軍徐瓊為兗州刺史，大將軍參軍申恬為冀州刺史。
In the tenth winter month, on jimao, left army general Xu Qiong became Yanzhou inspector and grand general staff officer Shen Tian Jizhou inspector.
156
二十二年春正月辛卯朔，改用御史中丞何承天元嘉新曆。 壬辰，撫軍將軍、南豫州刺史武陵王駿改為雍州刺史，湘州刺史南平王鑠為南豫州刺史。
On xinmao, new year’s day of year 22, the court adopted He Chengtian’s Yuanjia calendar. On renchen, Prince of Wuling Jun moved from Southern Yuzhou to Yongzhou, and Prince of Nanping Shuo from Xiangzhou to Southern Yuzhou.
157
二月辛巳，以侍中王僧朗為湘州刺史。 甲戌，立第八皇子褘為東海王，第九皇子昶為義陽王。
In the second month, on xinsi, palace attendant Wang Silang was appointed Xiangzhou inspector. On jiaxu, the eighth prince Hui was enfeoffed as Prince of Donghai and the ninth prince Chang as Prince of Yiyang.
158
夏六月辛亥，以南豫州刺史南平王鑠為豫州刺史。
On xinhai in the sixth summer month, Prince of Nanping Shuo was transferred from Southern Yuzhou to Yuzhou.
159
秋七月己未，以尚書僕射孟顗為尚書左僕射，中護軍何尚之為尚書右僕射。 雍州刺史武陵王駿討緣沔蠻，移一萬四千餘口於京師。 乙酉，征北大將軍、南兗州刺史衡陽王義季改為徐州刺史。
On jiwei in the seventh autumn month, Meng Yi became left vice director of the Masters of Writing and He Shangzhi right vice director. Prince of Wuling Jun, Yongzhou inspector, campaigned against Han River tribes and resettled more than fourteen thousand households at the capital. On yiyou, Prince of Hengyang Yiji was transferred from northern campaigning general and Southern Xuzhou to Xuzhou.
160
九月己未，[32]開酒禁。
On jiwei of the ninth month, [32] the ban on wine was revoked.
161
冬十月，起湖熟廢田千頃。
In the tenth winter month, a thousand qing of fallow land at Hushu were reopened.
162
十二月乙未，太子詹事范曄謀反，及黨與皆伏誅。 丁酉，免大將軍彭城王義康為庶人。 庚戌，以前豫州刺史趙伯符為護軍將軍。
On yiwei of the twelfth month, Fan Ye, crown prince household steward, was convicted of treason; he and his associates were put to death. On dingyou, Grand General Prince of Pengcheng Yikang was demoted to commoner status. On gengxu, former Yuzhou inspector Zhao Bofu was appointed general who protects the army.
163
二十三年春正月丁巳，以長沙內史陸徽為益州刺史。 庚申，尚書左僕射孟顗去職。 遷漢川流民於沔次。 [33]
On dingsi in the twenty-third year’s first spring month, Changsha interior minister Lu Hui became Yi Province inspector. On gengshen, left vice director Meng Yi resigned his post. Han River refugees were relocated to the banks of the Mian. Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
164
二月癸卯，以左衞將軍劉義賓為南兗州刺史。
On guimao in the second month, left guard general Liu Yibin was appointed Southern Xuzhou inspector.
165
三月，索虜寇兗、豫，青、冀刺史申恬破之。
In the third month the Northern Wei attacked Yan and Yu; Shen Tian, inspector of Qing and Ji, routed them.
166
夏四月丁未，大赦天下。
On dingwei in the fourth summer month a general amnesty was declared.
167
六月癸未朔，日有蝕之。 交州刺史檀和之伐林邑國，剋之。
On guiwei, new moon of the sixth month, the sun was eclipsed. Tan Hezhi, Jiao Province inspector, campaigned against Linyi and conquered the kingdom.
168
秋七月辛未，以散騎常侍杜坦為青州刺史。
On xinwei in the seventh autumn month, scattered cavalry regular attendant Du Tan became Qingzhou inspector.
169
八月癸卯，揭陽赭賊攻建安郡，燔燒城府。
On guimao of the eighth month, Jieyang’s cinnabar rebels stormed Jian’an, burning the prefectural seat.
170
九月己卯，車駕幸國子學，策試諸生，答問凡五十九人。
On jimao of the ninth month the emperor went to the Imperial Academy, tested the students, and fifty-nine answered satisfactorily.
171
冬十月戊子，詔曰：「庠序興立累載，冑子肄業有成。 近親策試，覩濟濟之美，緬想洙、泗，永懷在昔。 諸生答問，多可採覽。 教授之官，並宜沾賚。 」賜帛各有差。
On wuzi in the tenth winter month an edict declared: "Our academies have stood for years, and the crown students have finished their training." In testing them lately we saw their splendid ranks and, thinking of Zhu and Si, felt anew the age of the sages. Most of the students’ replies are fit to be read and kept. Their teachers in office are all to receive gifts." Silks were granted in graded amounts.
172
十二月丁酉，以龍驤司馬蕭景憲為交州刺史。
On dingyou of the twelfth month, rapid cavalry staff officer Xiao Jingxian was appointed Jiao Province inspector.
173
是歲，大有年。 築北堤，立玄武湖，築景陽山於華林園。
That year brought an abundant harvest. They built the northern dike, opened Black Tortoise Lake, and raised Jingyang Hill in Hualin Park.
174
二十四年春正月甲戌，大赦天下，文武賜位一等。 繫囚降宥，諸逋負寬減各有差。 孤老、六疾不能自存，人賜穀五斛。 蠲建康、秣陵二縣今年田租之半。
On jiaxu in the twenty-fourth year’s first spring month a general amnesty was declared and civil and military officials advanced one rank. Prisoners received graded pardons and overdue levies were eased by degree. Each orphan, solitary elder, or person disabled by the six infirmities who could not live without aid received five hu of grain. Jiankang and Moling were granted a half remission of this year’s land tax.
175
三月壬申，護軍將軍趙伯符遷職。
On renshen of the third month, Zhao Bofu left the post of general who protects the army.
176
夏五月甲戌，青州刺史杜坦加冀州刺史。
On jiaxu in the fifth summer month, Du Tan of Qingzhou was also made Jizhou inspector.
177
六月，京邑疫癘，丙戌，使郡縣及營署部司，普加履行，給以醫藥。 是月，以貨貴，制大錢一當兩。
In the sixth month plague ravaged the capital; on bingxu every commandery, county, camp, and office was ordered to tour its jurisdiction and provide medicine. That month, with prices high, large coins were decreed to pass at double value.
178
秋七月乙卯，以林邑所獲金銀寶物，班賚各有差。
On yimao in the seventh autumn month, booty of gold, silver, and gems from Linyi was handed out in graded gifts.
179
八月乙未，征北大將軍、徐州刺史衡陽王義季薨。 癸卯，以南兗州刺史劉義賓為徐州刺史。
On yiwei of the eighth month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, northern campaigning general and Xuzhou inspector, died. On guimao, Liu Yibin moved from Southern Xuzhou to Xuzhou.
180
九月己未，以中領軍沈演之為領軍將軍。 辛未，以太子詹事徐湛之為南兗州刺史。
On jiwei of the ninth month, Shen Yanzhi was promoted from central to full household guards general. On xinwei, crown prince household steward Xu Zhanzhi became Southern Xuzhou inspector.
181
冬十月壬午，豫章胡誕世反，殺太守桓隆之，前交州刺史檀和之南還至豫章，因討平之。 壬辰，以建平王宏為中護軍。
On renwu in the tenth winter month, Yuzhang’s Hu Danshi rose in revolt and slew the prefect; Tan Hezhi, former Jiao inspector returning south, crushed the rebellion at Yuzhang. On renchen, Prince of Jianping Hong was appointed general who protects the army.
182
十一月甲寅，立第十皇子渾為汝陰王。
On jiayin of the eleventh month, the tenth prince Hun was enfeoffed as Prince of Ruyin.
183
二十五年春正月戊辰，詔曰：「比者冰雪經旬，薪粒貴踊，貧弊之室，多有窘罄。 可檢行京邑二縣及營署，賜以柴米。」
On wuchen in the twenty-fifth year’s first spring month an edict declared: "Snow and ice have lingered for weeks; fuel and grain have soared, and many poor homes are at the edge of ruin." Inspect the two metropolitan counties and the military camps and issue firewood and grain."
184
二月庚寅，詔曰：「安不忘虞，經世之所同； 治兵教戰，有國之恒典。 故服訓明恥，然後少長知禁。 頃戎政雖修，而號令未審。 今宣武場始成，便可剋日大習眾軍。 當因校獵，肄武講事。」
On gengyin in the second month an edict declared: "Peace must not erase vigilance—every age has known this;" drilling troops and teaching battle is the standing law of any realm. Only when discipline and shame are clear do young and old learn their bounds. Military affairs have lately been kept up, but the commands are still vague. Now that the Martial Display Ground is finished, a day should be fixed for a grand review of all forces. A hunt is to accompany the review, to exercise arms and rehearse command."
185
閏月己酉，大蒐于宣武場。
On jiyou of the intercalary month a great hunt was held on the Martial Display Ground.
186
三月庚辰，車駕校獵。
On gengchen of the third month the emperor led a ceremonial hunt.
187
夏四月乙巳，新作閶闔、廣莫二門，改先廣莫門曰承明，開陽曰津陽。 乙卯，以撫軍將軍、雍州刺史武陵王駿為安北將軍、徐州刺史。 癸亥，以右衞將軍蕭思話為雍州刺史。
On yisi in the fourth summer month new Changle and Guangmo gates were built; old Guangmo became Chenming and Kaiyang became Jinyang. On yimao, Prince of Wuling Jun became northern pacifying general and Xuzhou inspector. On guihai, right guard general Xiao Sihua was appointed Yongzhou inspector.
188
五月己卯，罷大錢當兩。
On jimao of the fifth month the double-value large coin was withdrawn.
189
六月庚戌，零陵王司馬元瑜薨。 庚申，安北將軍、徐州刺史武陵王駿加兗州刺史。 丙寅，車騎將軍、荊州刺史南譙王義宣進位司空。
On gengxu, staff officer to the Prince of Lingling Sima Yuanyu died. On gengshen, Prince of Wuling Jun, northern pacifying general and Xuzhou inspector, was also made Yanzhou inspector. On bingyin, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, general of chariots and cavalry and Jingzhou inspector, was promoted to minister of works.
190
秋七月壬午，左光祿大夫王敬弘薨。
On renwu in the seventh autumn month, left grand master of splendid happiness Wang Jinghong died.
191
八月己酉，以撫軍參軍劉秀之為梁、南秦二州刺史。 甲子，立第十一皇子彧為淮陽王。
On jiyou of the eighth month, pacifying-army staff officer Liu Xiuzhi became inspector of Liang and Southern Qin. On jiazi, the eleventh prince Yu was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaiyang.
192
九月辛未，以尚書右僕射何尚之為尚書左僕射，領軍將軍沈演之遷職，吳興太守劉遵考為領軍將軍。
On xinwei of the ninth month, He Shangzhi became left vice director, Shen Yanzhi left the household guards, and Liu Zunkao of Wuxing became household guards general.
193
二十六年春正月辛巳，車駕親祠南郊。
On xinsi in the twenty-sixth year’s first spring month the emperor offered sacrifice at the southern suburb in person.
194
二月己亥，車駕陸道幸丹徒，謁京陵。
On jihai of the second month the emperor traveled overland to Dantu to worship at the Jing mausoleums.
195
三月丁巳，[34]詔曰：「朕違北京，二十餘載，雖云密邇，瞻塗莫從。 今因四表無塵，時和歲稔，復獲拜奉舊塋，展罔極之思，饗讌故老，申追遠之懷。 固以義兼於桑梓，情加於過沛，永言慷慨，感慰實深。 宜聿宣仁惠，覃被率土。 其大赦天下。 復丹徒縣僑舊今歲租布之半。 行所經縣，蠲田租之半。 二千石官長並勤勞王務，宜有沾錫。 登城三戰及大將戰亡墜沒之家，老病單弱者，普加贍卹。 遣使巡行百姓，問所疾苦。 孤老、鰥寡、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。 」遣使祭晉故司空忠肅公何無忌之墓。 乙丑，申南北沛下邳三郡復。 又詔曰：「京口肇祥自古，著符近代，衿帶江山，表裏華甸，經塗四達，利盡淮、海，城邑高明，土風淳壹，苞總形勝，實唯名都。 故能光宅靈心，克昌帝業。 頃年岳牧遷回，軍民徙散，廛里廬宇，不逮往日。 皇基舊鄉，地兼蕃重，宜令殷阜，式崇形望。 可募諸州樂移者數千家，給以田宅，并蠲復。」
On dingsi of the third month, [34] an edict declared: "For more than twenty years we have been absent from the northern capital; though close at hand on the map, we could not see the road home." Now, with the realm at peace and the harvest full, we can again worship at the ancestral graves, pour out unbounded mourning, feast the elders, and voice our longing for the dead. Our duty to home and our love for the old ford run deep; stirred beyond measure, we feel gratitude and solace alike. Benevolence should be proclaimed and kindness spread across the land. Let there be a general amnesty for the empire. Dantu’s migrant households receive a half remission of this year’s rent and cloth. Every county along the route receives a half remission of land tax. District magistrates who have labored faithfully in royal service deserve a share of favor. Families of men lost in the three city battles and in great engagements, and households of the aged, ill, and helpless, are to be sustained. Envoys will tour the people and inquire into their hardships. Each orphan, solitary elder, widower or widow, or person disabled by the six infirmities who cannot live without aid receives five hu of grain." Envoys were dispatched to offer sacrifice at the grave of Jin’s loyal minister of works, Lord He Wuji. On yichou, Northern Pei, Southern Pei, and Xiapi were granted tax relief. A further edict declared: "Jingkou has been blessed since antiquity and marked for empire in our own age—river and hills girdle it, roads meet from four sides, Huai and sea yield their profit, its towns are bright and its people unified; in holding all strategic strength it is truly a great capital." Hence it could quicken the imperial spirit and crown the founding with success. Lately, as governors have come and gone, troops and people have drifted away and the streets no longer match former bustle. The dynasty’s ancestral seat, doubly honored in rank, should be made rich and its prestige restored. Let several thousand households from other provinces who wish to relocate be enrolled, given land and dwellings, and granted tax exemptions."
196
五月丙寅，詔曰：「吾生於此城。 及盧循肆亂，害流茲境。 先帝以桑梓根本，實同休戚，復以蒙稚，猥同艱難，情義繾綣，夷險兼備，舊物遺蹤，猶存心目。 歲月不居，逝踰三紀，時人故老，與運零落。 眷惟既往，倍深感歎。 可搜訪于時士庶文武今尚存者，具以名聞。 人身已亡而子孫見在，優量賜賚之。 」車駕水路發丹徒，壬午，至京師。 丙戌，婆皇國，壬辰，婆達國，並遣使獻方物。
On bingyin of the fifth month an edict declared: "We were born in this city." When Lu Xun’s rebellion swept the land, this region suffered its ravages. The late Emperor held our native place as one body with the throne; in our youth we shared its hardships, and old scenes still live in memory. Time does not wait; thirty years have fled, and the elders of that day have mostly gone to their rest. Looking back, our grief is twice as deep. Seek out any civil or military men of that era, gentle or simple, who still live, and report their names in full." Where the man himself is gone but descendants survive, grant rewards after generous review." The emperor sailed from Dantu and on renwu reached the capital. On bingxu Pohuang and on renchen Bada each sent envoys with tribute.
197
秋七月辛未，以江州刺史廬陵王紹為南徐州刺史，廣陵王誕為雍州刺史。
On xinwei in the seventh autumn month, Prince of Luling Shao became Southern Xuzhou inspector and Prince of Guangling Dan Yongzhou inspector.
198
八月己酉，以中護軍建平王宏為江州刺史。 癸丑，以南豐王朗為湘州刺史。
On jiyou of the eighth month, Prince of Jianping Hong, general who protects the army, became Jiangzhou inspector. On guichou, Prince of Nanfeng Lang was appointed Xiangzhou inspector.
199
冬十月，廣陵王誕改封隨郡王。 甲辰，以中軍將軍、揚州刺史始興王濬為征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南徐兗二州刺史，南徐州刺史廬陵王紹為揚州刺史。
In the tenth winter month Prince of Guangling Dan was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Suixiang. On jiachen, Prince of Shixing Jun became northern campaigning general with opening office equal to the Three Excellencies and inspector of Southern Xu and Yan; Prince of Luling Shao became Yangzhou inspector.
200
二十七年春正月辛未，制交、寧二州假板郡縣，俸祿聽依臺除。 辛卯，百濟國遣使獻方物。
On xinwei in the twenty-seventh year’s first spring month, acting prefectures and counties in Jiao and Ning were regularized and salaries aligned with capital standards. On xinmao, Baekje sent envoys with tribute.
201
二月辛丑，右將軍、豫州刺史南平王鑠進號平西將軍。 辛亥，[35]索虜寇汝南諸郡，陳南頓二郡太守鄭琨、汝陽潁川二郡太守郭道隱委守走。 索虜攻懸瓠城，行汝南郡事陳憲拒之。 以軍興減百官俸三分之一。
On xinchou in the second month, Prince of Nanping Shuo, right general and Yuzhou inspector, was made pacifying-west general. [35] On xinhai the Northern Wei struck Runan; Zheng Kun of Chen and Nandun and Guo Daoyin of Ruyang and Yingchuan deserted their posts and fled. The Northern Wei besieged Xuanhu; Chen Xian, acting Runan administrator, held the city. With war upon the realm, every official salary was cut by a third.
202
三月乙丑，淮南太守諸葛闡求減俸祿同內百官，於是州及郡縣丞尉並悉同減。 戊寅，罷國子學。 乙酉，以新除吏部尚書蕭思話為護軍將軍。
On yichou in the third month, Huainan prefect Zhuge Chan asked that local salaries match the capital cut; province, commandery, assistant, and commandant pay were all reduced together. On wuyin the Imperial Academy was closed. On yiyou, newly appointed minister of personnel Xiao Sihua became general who protects the army.
203
夏四月壬子，安北將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍。 [36]
On renzi in the fourth summer month, Prince of Wuling Jun was demoted from northern pacifying general and Xu-Yan inspector to stabilizing-army general. Editorial footnote marker in the source text.
204
六月丁酉，侍中蕭斌為青、冀二州刺史。
On dingyou of the sixth month, palace attendant Xiao Bin became inspector of Qing and Ji.
205
秋七月庚午，遣寧朔將軍王玄謨北伐。 太尉江夏王義恭出次彭城，總統諸軍。 乙亥，索虜碻磝戍委城走。
On gengwu in the seventh autumn month, pacifying-north general Wang Xuamo was dispatched on the northern expedition. Grand Commandant Prince of Jiangxia Yigong marched to Pengcheng to take supreme command of the armies. On yihai the Northern Wei garrison at Qiaolao abandoned the fortress and withdrew.
206
冬閏月癸亥，玄謨攻滑臺，不克，為虜所敗，退還碻磝。 辛未，雍州刺史隨王誕遣軍攻弘農城，克之。 丙戌，又克關城。
On guihai of the winter intercalary month, Wang Xuamo assaulted Huatai, failed, was beaten by the enemy, and fell back to Qiaolao. On xinwei, Prince of Sui Dan, Yongzhou inspector, sent forces against Hongnong and captured it. On bingxu his troops also took Tong Pass.
207
十一月戊子，索虜陷鄒山，魯、陽平二郡太守崔邪利沒。 甲午，隨王誕所遣軍又攻陝城，克之。 癸卯，左軍將軍劉康祖於壽陽尉武戍與虜戰敗見殺。 丁未，大赦天下。
On wuzi of the eleventh month, Zou Mountain fell; Cui Xieli, prefect of Lu and Yangping, was taken prisoner. On jiawu, Dan’s detached force again stormed Shan city and took it. On guimao, left army general Liu Kangzu was defeated and slain at the Wuwei post near Shouyang. On dingwei a general amnesty was declared.
208
十二月戊午，內外纂嚴。 乙丑，冗從僕射胡崇之、太子積弩將軍臧澄之、建威將軍毛熙祚於盱眙與虜戰敗，並見殺。 庚午，虜偽主率大眾至瓜步。 壬午，內外戒嚴。
On wuwu of the twelfth month the court imposed martial law inside and out. On yichou, Hu Chongzhi, Zang Chengzhi, and Mao Xizuo were routed by the enemy at Xuyi and all slain. On gengwu the Northern Wei emperor advanced with a great army to Guabu. On renwu the court ordered precautionary martial law throughout the realm.
209
二十八年春正月丙戌朔，以寇逼不朝會。 丁亥，索虜自瓜步退走。 丁酉，攻圍盱眙城。 是月，寧朔將軍王玄謨自碻磝退還歷下。
On bingxu, new year’s day of year 28, the new-year audience was cancelled because the enemy was near. On dinghai the Northern Wei army retreated from Guabu. On dingyou they laid siege to Xuyi. That month Wang Xuamo withdrew from Qiaolao to Lixia.
210
二月丙辰，索虜自盱眙奔走。 癸酉，詔曰：「玁狁孔熾，難及數州，眷言念之，鑒寐興悼。 凶羯痍挫，迸跡遠奔，彫傷之民，宜時振理。 凡遭寇賊郡縣，令還復居業，封屍掩骼，賑贍饑流。 東作方始，務盡勸課。 貸給之宜，事從優厚。 其流寓江、淮者，並聽即屬，并蠲復稅調。 」甲戌，太尉、領司徒江夏王義恭降為驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司。 辛巳，鎮軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號北中郎將。 壬午，車駕幸瓜步，是日解嚴。
On bingchen of the second month the Northern Wei broke camp and fled from Xuyi. On guiyou an edict declared: "The northern foe rages across many provinces; we mourn them waking and sleeping." The enemy, battered and spent, has fled into the distance; the maimed people must be healed in good time. Every raided commandery and county is to bring people back to their trades, bury the dead, and feed the refugees. Spring planting has begun; press every effort in encouragement and oversight. Grain loans and relief are to be granted on generous terms. Refugees along the Yangzi and Huai may register locally and receive tax and corvée remissions." On jiaxu, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was demoted from grand commandant and minister over the masses to fast-cavalry general with opening office equal to the Three Excellencies. On xinsi, Prince of Wuling Jun was demoted from stabilizing-army general and Xu-Yan inspector to northern center commander. On renwu the emperor went to Guabu and martial precaution was lifted the same day.
211
三月乙酉，車駕還宮。 壬辰，征北將軍始興王濬解南兗州。 庚子，以輔國將軍臧質為雍州刺史。 戊申，徐州刺史武陵王駿為南兗州刺史。 甲寅，護軍將軍蕭思話為撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史。
On yiyou of the third month the emperor returned to the palace. On renchen, Prince of Shixing Jun gave up Southern Xuzhou. On gengzi, assisting-state general Zang Zhi became Yongzhou inspector. On wushen, Prince of Wuling Jun moved from Xuzhou to Southern Xuzhou. On jiayin, Xiao Sihua became pacifying-army general and inspector of Xu and Yan.
212
夏四月癸酉，婆達國遣使獻方物。 索虜偽寧南將軍魯爽、中書郎魯秀歸順。 戊寅，以爽為司州刺史。
On guiyou in the fourth summer month, Bada sent envoys with tribute. Northern Wei pacifying-south general Lu Shuang and secretariat gentleman Lu Xiu defected to the Song. On wuyin, Lu Shuang was appointed Sizhou inspector.
213
五月乙酉，亡命司馬順則自號齊王，據梁鄒城。 丁巳，婆皇國，戊戌，河南王，並遣使獻方物。 [37]己巳，驃騎將軍江夏王義恭領南兗州刺史。 戊申，以尚書左僕射何尚之為尚書令，太子詹事徐湛之為尚書僕射、護軍將軍。 壬子，以後將軍隨王誕為安南將軍、廣州刺史。
On yiyou of the fifth month, fugitive Sima Shunze declared himself king of Qi and held Liangzou. On dingsi Pohuang and on wuxu the king of Henan each sent envoys with tribute. [37] On jisi, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, fast-cavalry general, also became Southern Xuzhou inspector. On renzi, He Shangzhi became director of the Masters of Writing, and Xu Zhanzhi vice director and general who protects the army. On renyin, Prince of Sui Dan became southern pacifying general and Guangzhou inspector.
214
六月壬戌，以北中郎將武陵王駿為江州刺史，以振武將軍、秦郡太守劉興祖為青、冀二州刺史。
On renxu of the sixth month, Prince of Wuling Jun became Jiangzhou inspector, and Liu Xingzu of Qin commandery inspector of Qing and Ji.
215
秋七月甲辰，安東將軍倭王倭濟進號安東大將軍。
On jiachen in the seventh autumn month, the Wa king Yuji was promoted from pacifying-east general to pacifying-east grand general.
216
八月癸亥，梁鄒平，斬司馬順則。
On guihai of the eighth month Liangzou was taken and Sima Shunze executed.
217
冬十月癸亥，高麗國遣使獻方物。
On guihai in the tenth winter month, Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
218
十一月壬寅，曲赦二兗、徐、豫、青、冀六州。 是冬，徙彭城流民於瓜步，淮西流民於姑孰，合萬許家。
