On renyin of the eleventh month a partial amnesty was granted to the two Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji. That winter Pengcheng refugees were moved to Guabu and Huai-west refugees to Gushu—roughly ten thousand families in all.
219
二十九年春正月甲午，詔曰：「經寇六州，居業未立，[38]仍值災澇，饑困荐臻。 可速符諸鎮，優量救卹。 今農事行興，務盡地利。 若須田種，隨宜給之。」
On jiawu in the twenty-ninth year’s first spring month an edict declared: "Six raided provinces have not yet rebuilt their livelihoods, [38] and now floods have struck again; hunger follows hunger." Send urgent orders to the frontier commands to relieve the people generously. Spring work is underway; exploit every advantage of the soil. Where seed is lacking, issue it as local conditions require."
220
二月庚申，虜帥拓跋燾死。 戊午，[39]立第十二皇子休仁為建安王。
On gengshen in the second month the Northern Wei emperor Tuoba Tao died. On wuwu, [39] the twelfth prince Xiuren was enfeoffed as Prince of Jian’an.
221
夏四月戊午，訶羅單國遣使獻方物。 以驃騎參軍張永為冀州刺史。
On wuwu in the fourth summer month, Heluodan sent envoys with tribute. Zhang Yong, staff officer to the fast-cavalry general, became Jizhou inspector.
222
五月甲午，罷湘州并荊州。 以始興、臨賀、始安三郡屬廣州，丙申，詔曰：「惡稔身滅，戎醜常數，虐虜窮凶，著於自昔。 未勞資斧，已伏天誅，子孫相殘，親黨離貳，關、洛偽帥，並懷內款，河朔遺民，注誠請効。 拯溺蕩穢，今其會也。 可符驃騎、司空二府，各部分所統，東西應接。 歸義建績者，隨勞酬獎。 」是月，京邑雨水。
On jiawu of the fifth month Xiangzhou was abolished and absorbed into Jingzhou. On bingchen an edict declared: "Evil ripened brings ruin; the northern foe has always been so; their savage ruler, steeped in cruelty, has shown it since antiquity." We need not even swing the axe: they have already met Heaven’s judgment; their heirs turn on one another and their kin divide; the puppet warlords of Guan and Luo all wish to come over, and refugees north of the River offer their loyalty and beg to fight for us. To save the perishing and cleanse the realm—this is the hour. Issue orders to the Agile Cavalry and Minister of Works staffs, each to deploy its commands and coordinate east and west. Defectors who prove their worth shall be rewarded in proportion to their service. " That month flooding rains struck the capital.
223
六月己酉，遣部司巡行，賜樵米，給船。 撫軍將軍蕭思話率眾北伐。 以征北從事中郎劉瑀為益州刺史。
Sixth month, jiyou: touring officials were sent out, fuel and grain distributed, and boats provided. Pacifying-army general Xiao Sihua marched north at the head of his army. Liu Yu, staff officer to the campaigning-north general, was appointed inspector of Yi.
224
秋七月壬辰，汝陰王渾改封武昌王，淮陽王彧改封湘東王。 丁酉，省大司農、太子僕、廷尉監官。
Autumn, seventh month, renchen: Prince of Ruyin Hun became Prince of Wuchang; Prince of Huaiyang Yu became Prince of Xiangdong. Dingyou: the grand minister of agriculture, heir-apparent steward, and court-of-justice supervisor posts were cut.
225
八月丁卯，蕭思話攻碻磝，不拔，退還。
Eighth month, dingmao: Xiao Sihua assaulted Qiaoyao, failed to capture it, and retreated.
226
九月丁亥，以平西將軍吐谷渾拾寅為安西將軍、秦河二州刺史。 己丑，撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史蕭思話加冀州刺史，兗州如故。
Ninth month, dinghai: Tuyuhun Shibin, pacifying-west general, was made Anxi general and inspector of Qin and He. Jichou: pacifying-army general and Xu-Yan inspector Xiao Sihua also received Ji; his Yanzhou post was unchanged.
227
冬十月癸亥，司州刺史魯爽攻虎牢不拔，退還。
Winter, tenth month, guihai: Si inspector Lu Shuang besieged Hulao, failed, and withdrew.
228
十一月壬寅，揚州刺史廬陵王紹薨。
Eleventh month, renyin: Prince of Luling Shao, inspector of Yang, died.
229
十二月辛未，以驃騎將軍、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為大將軍、南徐州刺史，錄尚書事如故。
Twelfth month, xinwei: agile-cavalry general and Southern Yanzhou inspector Prince of Jiangxia Yigong became grand general and Southern Xuzhou inspector, still supervising the Masters of Writing.
230
三十年春正月戊寅，以司空、荊州刺史南譙王義宣為司徒、中軍將軍、揚州刺史。 以南兗州并南徐州。 庚辰，以領軍將軍劉遵考為平西將軍、豫州刺史。 壬午，以征北將軍、南徐州刺史始興王濬為衛將軍、荊州刺史。 戊子，江州刺史武陵王駿統眾軍伐西陽蠻。 癸巳，以豫州刺史南平王鑠為撫軍將軍、領軍將軍。
Year 30, first spring month, wuyin: minister of works and Jing inspector Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan became grand secretary, central army commander, and Yangzhou inspector. Southern Yan was absorbed into Southern Xu. Gengchen: guards colonel Liu Zunkao was made pacifying-west general and Yu inspector. Renwu: campaigning-north general and Southern Xu inspector Prince of Shixing Jun became guard general and Jing inspector. Wuzi: Prince of Wuling Jun led the combined armies against the Xiyang tribes. Guisi: Yu inspector Prince of Nanping Shuo became pacifying-army general and guards colonel.
231
青、徐州饑，二月壬子，遣運部賑卹。
Famine in Qing and Xu: second month, renzi, the transport office was sent to relieve distress.
232
甲子，上崩于含章殿。 時年四十七。 諡曰景皇帝，廟曰中宗。 三月癸巳，葬長寧陵。 世祖踐阼，追改諡及廟號。
Jiazi: the emperor died in Hanzhang Hall. He was forty-seven. Posthumous title Emperor Jing; temple name Zhongzong. Third month, guisi: interment at Changning Mausoleum. Once Shizu acceded, he revised the posthumous and temple designations.
233
史臣曰：太祖幼年特秀，顧無保傅之嚴，而天授和敏之姿，自禀君人之德。 及正位南面，歷年長久，綱維備舉，條禁明密，罰有恒科，爵無濫品。 故能內清外晏，四海謐如也。 昔漢氏東京常稱建武、永平故事，自茲厥後，亦每以元嘉為言，斯固盛矣。 授將遣帥，乖分閫之命，才謝光武，而遙制兵略，至於攻日戰時，莫不仰聽成旨。 雖覆師喪旅，將非韓、白，而延寇慼境，抑此之由。 及至言漏衾衽，難結商豎，雖禍生非慮，蓋亦有以而然也。 嗚呼哀哉！
The historian writes: The Founding Emperor showed rare promise as a boy; without rigid tutoring he still possessed Heaven-given harmony and quickness—the makings of a true sovereign. Once enthroned he ruled many years: institutions were complete, law meticulous, penalties standardized, and ennoblement never careless. Hence the realm was ordered within and calm without—all under Heaven was still. Han scholars praised Jianwu and Yongping; later ages likewise held up Yuanjia as a golden age—and rightly so. He named generals yet withheld their command: no Guangwu in talent, but he micromanaged every campaign—on the day of battle his officers waited only for edicts from the throne. Defeats piled up and his commanders were no match for Han Xin or Bai Qi; still, that the foe prolonged the war and ravaged the marches owed much to this habit. When whispers escaped the royal bed and a merchant’s grudge entangled the court, disaster seemed sudden—yet the seeds had long been sown. Alas—how pitiable!
234
校勘記
Textual collation notes
235
車駕至京城孫虨宋書考論云：「當作京邑。 京城則京口矣。 」按通鑑作建康。 宋書京城往往指京口城，此則指建康。
Imperial arrival at Jingcheng. Sun Ao’s Song History Studies: "Read Jingyi (metropolis), not Jingcheng." Jingcheng here means Jingkou (modern Zhenjiang). " Zizhi Tongjian has Jiankang. Song Shu usually uses Jingcheng for Jingkou; this passage means Jiankang (Nanjing).
236
辛未車駕祠南郊各本並脫「辛未」二字，據南史、建康實錄、通鑑補。
Xinwei, imperial southern-suburb sacrifice: every edition drops xinwei; restored from Nanshi, Jiankang shilu, and Tongjian.
237
建安太守潘盛有罪伏誅「潘盛」各本作「潘城」，據少帝紀、徐羨之傳改。
Jian’an administrator Pan Sheng executed for crime. All texts read Pan Cheng; corrected per the deposed emperor’s annals and Xu Xianzhi’s biography.
238
乙卯各本並作「己卯」，據局本及南史改。 按是月丁酉朔，十九日乙卯，無己卯。
Yimao: every edition has jimao; emended per the Bureau text and Nanshi. That month’s new moon was dingyou; day 19 was yimao, so jimao is impossible.
239
領平北將軍南徐州刺史各本並脫「南」字，按彭城王義康傳、建康實錄、通鑑並作南徐州刺史，今據補。
Pacifying-north general and Southern Xu inspector: all editions drop Nan (south); Pengcheng prince’s biography, Jiankang shilu, and Tongjian agree—Nan restored.
240
以前征虜司馬尹沖為司州刺史各本並脫「尹」字，按索虜傳，時尹沖為司州刺史，通鑑同。 今據補。
Yin Chong, former campaigning-north staff officer, made Si inspector: Yin is missing in all editions; the Rouran biography and Tongjian confirm him in office. Restored accordingly.
241
征南大將軍檀道濟破索虜於東平壽張各本並脫「平」字。 據檀道濟傳補。 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「按檀道濟傳作東平壽張，此『東』下脫『平』字。」
Tan Daoji, campaigning-south grand general, routed the northerners at Dongping Shouzhang: every edition omits ping in Dongping. Added from Tan Daoji’s biography. Hong Yixuan, Various Histories: "Tan Daoji’s biography has Dongping Shouzhang—ping is missing after Dong."
242
苟不深存務本各本並脫「苟」字，據元龜一九八補。
"If one does not deeply preserve the root task": gou (if) is absent in all editions; supplied from Yuan gui 198.
243
以吐谷渾慕容延為平東將軍「慕容延」本書吐谷渾傳作「慕延」。 魏書作「慕利延」。
Tuyuhun Murong Yan made pacifying-east general: the Tuyuhun biography in this book reads Mu Yan. Wei Shu: Muli Yan.
244
吐谷渾輝伐為鎮軍將軍各本並脫「谷」字，據前後文例補。 「輝伐」魏書作「緯代」。
Tuyuhun Hui Fa made pacifying-army general: Gu in Tuyuhun is dropped in all editions; restored by context. Wei Shu: Weidai for Huifa.
245
壬申河南國河西王遣使獻方物「河西王」各本作「西河王」，據少帝紀景平元年及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。
Renshen: Henan and Hexi kings sent tribute missions. Xihe in all texts should be Hexi; corrected per the deposed emperor’s annals (Jingping 1) and Juqu Mengxun’s biography.
246
亡命馬大玄羣黨數百人寇泰山三朝本作「泰山」，弘治本、北監本、毛本、殿本、局本作「秦梁」。
Rebel Ma Daxuan, several hundred strong, raided Taishan. Sanchao has Taishan; Hongzhi, Beijian, Mao, Dian, and Bureau texts read Qinliang.
247
夏四月乙酉按是月丁亥朔，無乙酉。 二十三日己酉，「乙酉」或是「己酉」之譌。
Summer, fourth month, yiyou: that month’s new moon was dinghai, so yiyou cannot stand. Day 23 was jiyou; yiyou is likely a scribal error for jiyou.
248
秋七月辛酉「辛酉」各本並作「乙酉」，據南史改。 按是月庚戌朔，初六日辛酉，無「乙酉」。
Autumn, seventh month, xinyou: every edition has yiyou; corrected per Nanshi. New moon gengxu; day 6 xinyou—yiyou is impossible.
249
於益州立南晉壽南新巴北巴西三郡各本並作「於益州立南晉壽新巴西三郡」。 孫虨宋書考論云：「據州郡志，是南晉壽、南新巴、北巴西三郡。 」按孫說是，今訂正。 又此條上云「壬申」，下云「乙亥」。 按是月丙戌朔，無壬申，亦無乙亥。
Yi Province gained three commanderies—Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, Northern Baxi. All editions collapse them to Southern Jinshou, Xinba, and Baxi. Sun Ao’s Song Studies: the Provincial Gazetteer lists Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi. " Sun is right; text emended. This note also has renshen above and yihai below. That month’s new moon was bingxu; neither renshen nor yihai occurs.
250
以步兵校尉劉真道為梁南秦二州刺史「劉真道」各本並作「劉道真」。 張森楷校勘記云：「當作劉真道，見劉懷肅傳，下十八年亦作劉真道。 」按張說是，今改正。
Footsoldier colonel Liu Zhendao made Liang and Southern Qin inspector: all editions read Liu Daozhen. Zhang Senkai: read Liu Zhendao (Liu Huaisu biography; year-18 entry agrees). " Zhang is correct; emended.
251
河南國河西王訶羅單國並遣使獻方物「河西王」各本並作「西河王」，據少帝紀及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。
Henan king, Hexi king, Heluodan, and Poluo Huang sent tribute. Xihe for Hexi in all texts—corrected per deposed-emperor annals and Juqu Mengxun.
252
燕王弘遣使獻方物「弘」各本並作「年」，據晉書載記改。
Yan prince Hong sent tribute: nian in all editions should be Hong, per Jin Shu annals.
253
今年有不收處「年」各本並作「半」，據元龜四八九改。
"Where this year there are places without harvest": nian (year) appears as ban (half) in all editions; fixed per Yuan gui 489.
254
以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射「王球」各本並作「王琳」，據南史、通鑑改。 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「王球作王琳，是傳寫之譌。」
Wang Qiu, director of the Masters of Writing, made vice director: Wang Lin in all texts—corrected per Nanshi and Tongjian. Hong Yixuan: Wang Qiu miswritten Wang Lin is a copyist’s error.
255
夏五月壬午「壬午」各本作「壬申」。 局本作「壬午」。 按是月壬午朔，無壬申。 今從局本。
Summer, fifth month, renwu: all editions have renshen. Bureau text: renwu. That month’s new moon was renwu; renshen is impossible. Adopted from the Bureau edition.
256
尚書僕射王球卒「球」各本並作「琳」，據南史、通鑑改。
Vice director Wang Qiu died: Lin in all texts should be Qiu, per Nanshi and Tongjian.
257
是月各本並作十二月。 按上已有十月，十一月，十二月，不當重出十二月。 今改作是月。
"That month": every edition says twelfth month. Tenth, eleventh, and twelfth months already appear above—a second twelfth month is wrong. Changed to "that month."
258
盛王聖世「聖」各本並作「祖」，據元龜一九四改。
"Flourishing age, sagely world": sheng (sagely) is zu (ancestral) in all editions; emended per Yuan gui 194.
259
始奉礿祠「礿」各本並作「初」，據元龜二０七改。
"For the first time performing the yue sacrifice": yue is chu (initial) in all editions; fixed per Yuan gui 207.
260
庚申各本同。 按是月壬申朔，初三日甲戌，是月無庚申。 下有甲申，為十三日。 甲戌、甲申之間有庚辰。 庚申疑庚辰之譌。
Gengshen: all editions agree. New moon renshen; day 3 jiaxu—no gengshen that month. Jiashen below is day 13. Between jiaxu and jiashen stands gengchen. Gengshen is probably a mistake for gengchen.
261
南徐南豫州揚州之浙江西各本同。 南史於「南徐」下有「南兗」二字。
Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and Yang west of the Zhe: all editions agree. Nanshi inserts Southern Yan after Southern Xu.
262
南豫州刺史武陵王駿加撫軍將軍「駿」各本作「贊」，三朝本作「諱」。 按時武陵王駿，即後之孝武帝。 贊為宋明帝第九子，後亦封武陵王，時尚未生。 今改作「駿」。
Southern Yu inspector Prince of Wuling Jun made pacifying-army general: Jun is Zan in all texts, taboo in Sanchao. At this date Prince of Wuling Jun is the future Emperor Xiaowu. Zan is Emperor Ming’s ninth son, later Prince of Wuling too—but not yet born here. Corrected to Jun.
263
征北將軍南徐州刺史南譙王義宣為車騎將軍荊州刺史「南徐州刺史」各本並脫「南」字，據義宣傳補。
Campaigning-north general, Southern Xu inspector Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan became chariots-and-cavalry general and Jing inspector: Nan (south) is missing before Southern Xu; restored from Yixuan’s biography.
264
九月己未「己未」各本並作「乙未」，局本作「己未」。 按是月丁巳朔，初三日己未，無乙未。 今從局本。
Ninth month jiwei: yimao in all texts, jiwei in the Bureau edition. New moon dingsi; day 3 jiwei—yimao cannot occur. Adopted from the Bureau edition.
265
遷漢川流民於沔次「漢川」各本作「漢州」，按時無「漢州」，據元龜四八六改。
Resettling Hanchuan refugees on the Han shore: every edition has Hanzhou instead of Hanchuan, but no Hanzhou existed then; emended per Yuan gui 486.
266
三月丁巳下有乙丑。 各本同。 按是月丁卯朔，無丁巳，亦無乙丑。 四月丙申朔，二十二日丁巳，三十日乙丑。
Third month dingsi; yichou follows below. Every edition is the same. Per the calendar the third-month new moon fell on dingmao; neither dingsi nor yichou could occur. Fourth-month new moon bingchen; day 22 was dingsi and day 30 yichou.
267
辛亥各本並作「辛巳」。 通鑑考異云：「按長曆，二月壬辰朔，十日辛丑，二十日辛亥。 辛巳當作辛亥。 」今據改。
Xinhai: all editions have xinsi. Zizhi Tongjian Collation says: "Per the long calendar, second-month new moon renchen, tenth day xinchou, twentieth day xinhai. Xinsi should read xinhai." Emended accordingly.
268
安北將軍徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍「駿」宋本作「諱」。 三朝本、北監本、毛本、殿本作「贊」，今據孝武帝紀訂正。 說見本卷校勘記第三十條。
Pacifying-north general and Xu-Yan inspector Prince of Wuling Jun was demoted to pacifying-army general; the Song edition uses the taboo form for Jun. Sanchao, Beijian, Mao, and Dian editions read Zan; corrected per the Xiaowu annals. See textual collation note 30 in this juan.
269
五月乙酉亡命司馬順則自號齊王據梁鄒城丁巳婆皇國戊戌河南王並遣使獻方物按是年五月甲申朔，初二日乙酉，十五日戊戌，無丁巳。 丁巳日支當有誤。
Fifth month yiyou: rebel Sima Shunze declared himself King of Qi and seized Liangzhou; entries for dingsi (Poluo Huang) and wuxu (Henan King) with tribute missions cannot stand—that month’s new moon was jiashen (day 2 yiyou, day 15 wuxu), with no dingsi. The dingsi date is certainly wrong.
270
居業未立「立」各本並作「能」，據元龜一九五改。
"Livelihoods not yet established": every edition has neng (able) for li (established); emended per Yuan gui 195.
271
戊午各本並作「庚午」，據南史改。 按是月庚戌朔，無庚午。 初九日戊午。
Wuwu: all editions read gengwu; corrected per Nanshi. That month’s new moon was gengxu; gengwu is impossible. Day 9 was wuwu.
